## Join a conference

<a id="opIdconferenceJoin"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/conferences/string/actions/join \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "beep_enabled": "always",
    "call_control_id": "v2:T02llQxIyaRkhfRKxgAP8nY511EhFLizdvdUKJiSw8d6A9BborherQ",
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
    "end_conference_on_exit": true,
    "hold": true,
    "hold_audio_url": "http://www.example.com/audio.wav",
    "mute": true,
    "start_conference_on_enter": true,
    "supervisor_role": "whisper",
    "whisper_call_control_ids": [
      "v2:Sg1xxxQ_U3ixxxyXT_VDNI3xxxazZdg6Vxxxs4-GNYxxxVaJPOhFMRQ",
      "v2:qqpb0mmvd-ovhhBr0BUQQn0fld5jIboaaX3-De0DkqXHzbf8d75xkw"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /conferences/{id}/actions/join`

Join an existing call leg to a conference. Issue the Join Conference command with the conference ID in the path and the `call_control_id` of the leg you wish to join to the conference as an attribute.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `conference.participant.joined`
- `conference.participant.left`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "beep_enabled": "always",
  "call_control_id": "v2:T02llQxIyaRkhfRKxgAP8nY511EhFLizdvdUKJiSw8d6A9BborherQ",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "end_conference_on_exit": true,
  "hold": true,
  "hold_audio_url": "http://www.example.com/audio.wav",
  "mute": true,
  "start_conference_on_enter": true,
  "supervisor_role": "whisper",
  "whisper_call_control_ids": [
    "v2:Sg1xxxQ_U3ixxxyXT_VDNI3xxxazZdg6Vxxxs4-GNYxxxVaJPOhFMRQ",
    "v2:qqpb0mmvd-ovhhBr0BUQQn0fld5jIboaaX3-De0DkqXHzbf8d75xkw"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="join-a-conference-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Uniquely identifies the conference by id or name|
|body|body|[JoinConferenceRequest](#schemajoinconferencerequest)|true|Join Conference request object|
|» beep_enabled|body|string|false|Whether a beep sound should be played when the participant joins and/or leaves the conference. Can be used to override the conference-level setting.|
|» call_control_id|body|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid execution of duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore subsequent commands with the same `command_id` as one that has already been executed.|
|» end_conference_on_exit|body|boolean|false|Whether the conference should end and all remaining participants be hung up after the participant leaves the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|» hold|body|boolean|false|Whether the participant should be put on hold immediately after joining the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|» hold_audio_url|body|string|false|The URL of a file to be played to the participant when they are put on hold after joining the conference. hold_media_name and hold_audio_url cannot be used together in one request. Takes effect only when "start_conference_on_create" is set to "false". This property takes effect only if "hold" is set to "true".|
|» hold_media_name|body|string|false|The media_name of a file to be played to the participant when they are put on hold after joining the conference. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file. Takes effect only when "start_conference_on_create" is set to "false". This property takes effect only if "hold" is set to "true".|
|» mute|body|boolean|false|Whether the participant should be muted immediately after joining the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|» soft_end_conference_on_exit|body|boolean|false|Whether the conference should end after the participant leaves the conference. NOTE this doesn't hang up the other participants. Defaults to "false".|
|» start_conference_on_enter|body|boolean|false|Whether the conference should be started after the participant joins the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|» supervisor_role|body|string|false|Sets the joining participant as a supervisor for the conference. A conference can have multiple supervisors. "barge" means the supervisor enters the conference as a normal participant. This is the same as "none". "monitor" means the supervisor is muted but can hear all participants. "whisper" means that only the specified "whisper_call_control_ids" can hear the supervisor. Defaults to "none".|
|» whisper_call_control_ids|body|[string]|false|Array of unique call_control_ids the joining supervisor can whisper to. If none provided, the supervisor will join the conference as a monitoring participant only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» beep_enabled|always|
|» beep_enabled|never|
|» beep_enabled|on_enter|
|» beep_enabled|on_exit|
|» supervisor_role|barge|
|» supervisor_role|monitor|
|» supervisor_role|none|
|» supervisor_role|whisper|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "result": "ok"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="join-a-conference-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response upon making a conference command.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized response. Happens when the current user is not a manager account.|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity|None|

<h3 id="join-a-conference-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[ConferenceCommandResult](#schemaconferencecommandresult)|false|none|none|

<h3 id="join-a-conference-callbacks">Callbacks</h3>

|Name|Expression|Method|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|conferenceParticipantJoined|{$request.body#/webhook_url}|POST|none|
|conferenceParticipantLeft|{$request.body#/webhook_url}|POST|none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BearerAuth

```bash
  }'
```

`POST /conferences/{id}/actions/record_start`

Start recording the conference. Recording will stop on conference end, or via the Stop Recording command.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `conference.recording.saved`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "channels": "single",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "format": "wav",
  "max_length": 0,
  "play_beep": true
}
```

<h3 id="conference-recording-start-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Specifies the conference to record by id or name|
|body|body|[StartRecordingRequest](#schemastartrecordingrequest)|true|none|
|» channels|body|string|true|When `dual`, final audio file will be stereo recorded with the first leg on channel A, and the rest on channel B.|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore commands with the same `command_id`.|
|» format|body|string|true|The audio file format used when storing the call recording. Can be either `mp3` or `wav`.|
|» max_length|body|integer(int32)|false|Defines the maximum length for the recording in seconds. Minimum value is 0. Maximum value is 14400. Default is 0 (infinite)|
|» play_beep|body|boolean|false|If enabled, a beep sound will be played at the start of a recording.|

|» channels|single|
|» channels|dual|
|» format|wav|
|» format|mp3|

```json
  }
}
```

Update conference participant supervisor_role

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "call_control_id": "v2:T02llQxIyaRkhfRKxgAP8nY511EhFLizdvdUKJiSw8d6A9BborherQ",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",

  "whisper_call_control_ids": [
    "v2:Sg1xxxQ_U3ixxxyXT_VDNI3xxxazZdg6Vxxxs4-GNYxxxVaJPOhFMRQ",

  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-conference-participant-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Uniquely identifies the conference by id or name|
|body|body|[UpdateConferenceRequest](#schemaupdateconferencerequest)|true|Update Conference request object|
|» call_control_id|body|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid execution of duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore subsequent commands with the same `command_id` as one that has already been executed.|
|» supervisor_role|body|string|true|Sets the participant as a supervisor for the conference. A conference can have multiple supervisors. "barge" means the supervisor enters the conference as a normal participant. This is the same as "none". "monitor" means the supervisor is muted but can hear all participants. "whisper" means that only the specified "whisper_call_control_ids" can hear the supervisor. Defaults to "none".|
|» whisper_call_control_ids|body|[string]|false|Array of unique call_control_ids the supervisor can whisper to. If none provided, the supervisor will join the conference as a monitoring participant only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» supervisor_role|barge|
|» supervisor_role|monitor|
|» supervisor_role|none|
|» supervisor_role|whisper|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "result": "ok"
  }
}
```

## List connections

<a id="opIdlistConnections"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/connections \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

```

`GET /connections`

Returns a list of your connections irrespective of type.

<h3 id="list-connections-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|
|filter[connection_name][contains]|query|string|false|If present, connections with <code>connection_name</code> containing the given value will be returned. Matching is not case-sensitive. Requires at least three characters.|
|filter[outbound_voice_profile_id]|query|string(int64)|false|Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.|
|sort|query|string|false|Specifies the sort order for results. By default sorting direction is ascending. To have the results sorted in descending order add the <code> -</code> prefix.<br/><br/><br>That is: <ul><br>  <li><br>    <code>connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in ascending order.<br>  </li><br><br>  <li><br>    <code>-connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in descending order.<br>  </li><br></ul> <br/> If not given, results are sorted by <code>created_at</code> in descending order.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort|created_at|
|sort|connection_name|
|sort|active|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "active": true,
      "anchorsite_override": "Latency",
      "connection_name": "string",
      "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
      "id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
      "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499",
      "record_type": "ip_connection",
      "updated_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
      "webhook_api_version": "1",
      "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
      "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page_number": 2,
    "page_size": 25,
    "total_pages": 3,
    "total_results": 55
  }
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|404|Not Found|Resource not found|None|

<h3 id="create-a-credential-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateCredentialConnectionRequest](#schemacreatecredentialconnectionrequest)|true|Parameters that can be defined during credential connection creation|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Defaults to true|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» connection_name|body|string|true|none|
|» default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, Telnyx will generate comfort noise when you place the call on hold. If disabled, you will need to generate comfort noise or on hold music to avoid RTP timeout.|
|» dtmf_type|body|[DtmfType](#schemadtmftype)|false|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|» encode_contact_header_enabled|body|boolean|false|Encode the SIP contact header sent by Telnyx to avoid issues for NAT or ALG scenarios.|
|» encrypted_media|body|[EncryptedMedia](#schemaencryptedmedia)|false|Enable use of SRTP or ZRTP for encryption. Valid values are those listed or null. Cannot be set to non-null if the transport_portocol is TLS.|
|» inbound|body|[CredentialInbound](#schemacredentialinbound)|false|none|
|» onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled|body|boolean|false|Enable on-net T38 if you prefer the sender and receiver negotiating T38 directly if both are on the Telnyx network. If this is disabled, Telnyx will be able to use T38 on just one leg of the call depending on each leg's settings.|
|» outbound|body|[CredentialOutbound](#schemacredentialoutbound)|false|none|
|» password|body|string|true|The password to be used as part of the credentials. Must be 8 to 128 characters long.|
|» rtcp_settings|body|[ConnectionRtcpSettings](#schemaconnectionrtcpsettings)|false|none|
|» sip_uri_calling_preference|body|string|false|This feature enables inbound SIP URI calls to your Credential Auth Connection. If enabled for all (unrestricted) then anyone who calls the SIP URI <your-username>@telnyx.com will be connected to your Connection. You can also choose to allow only calls that are originated on any Connections under your account (internal).|
|» user_name|body|string|true|The user name to be used as part of the credentials. Must be 4-32 characters long and alphanumeric values only (no spaces or special characters).|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1 or v2.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string(url) \| null|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(url)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer \| null|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|


`GET /telephony_credentials`

List all On-demand Credentials.

<h3 id="list-all-credentials-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|
|filter[tag]|query|string|false|Filter by tag|
|filter[name]|query|string|false|Filter by name|
|filter[status]|query|string|false|Filter by status|
|filter[resource_id]|query|string|false|Filter by resource_id|
|filter[sip_username]|query|string|false|Filter by sip_username|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "created_at": "2020-06-18T21:32:38",
      "expired": "false",
      "expires_at": "2042-06-18T21:32:38",
      "id": "c215ade3-0d39-418e-94be-c5f780760199",
      "name": "2020-06-18 21:32:38.917732Z",
      "record_type": "credential",
      "resource_id": "connection:804252963366242252",
      "sip_password": "a92dbcfb60184a8cb330b0acb2f7617b",
      "sip_username": "gencrednCvHU5IYpSBPPsXI2iQsDX",
      "updated_at": "2020-06-18T21:32:38.000Z",
      "user_id": "user-id"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page_number": 2,
    "page_size": 25,
    "total_pages": 3,
    "total_results": 55
  }
}
```

|200|OK|Successful response with multiple credentials|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Resource not found|None|

<h3 id="list-all-credentials-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[[TelephonyCredential](#schematelephonycredential)]|false|none|none|
|meta|[PaginationMeta](#schemapaginationmeta)|false|none|none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

## Create a credential

<a id="opIdCreateTelephonyCredential"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/telephony_credentials \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "connection_id": "1234567890",
    "name": "My-new-credential"
  }'
```

`POST /telephony_credentials`

Create a credential.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "connection_id": "1234567890",
  "name": "My-new-credential"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-credential-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[TelephonyCredentialCreateRequest](#schematelephonycredentialcreaterequest)|true|Parameters that can be defined during credential creation|
|» connection_id|body|string|true|Identifies the Credential Connection this credential is associated with.|
|» expires_at|body|string|false|ISO-8601 formatted date indicating when the credential will expire.|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» tag|body|string|false|Tags a credential to filter for bulk operations. A single tag can hold at maximum 1000 credentials.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "created_at": "2020-06-18T21:32:38",
    "expired": "false",
    "expires_at": "2042-06-18T21:32:38",
    "id": "c215ade3-0d39-418e-94be-c5f780760199",
    "name": "2020-06-18 21:32:38.917732Z",
    "record_type": "credential",
    "resource_id": "connection:804252963366242252",
    "sip_password": "a92dbcfb60184a8cb330b0acb2f7617b",
    "sip_username": "gencrednCvHU5IYpSBPPsXI2iQsDX",
    "updated_at": "2020-06-18T21:32:38.000Z",
    "user_id": "user-id"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-credential-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response with details about a credential|Inline|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Bad request|None|

<h3 id="create-a-credential-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[TelephonyCredential](#schematelephonycredential)|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BearerAuth
</aside>

## Perform activate or deactivate action on provided Credential

<a id="opIdtelephonyCredentialAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/telephony_credentials/string/actions/activate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /telephony_credentials/{id}/actions/{action}`

Perform activate or deactivate action on provided Credential. Activate action will change the status to active, making it possible to connect calls with the credential. Deactivate action will change the status to inactive, making it impossible to connect calls with the credential.

<h3 id="perform-activate-or-deactivate-action-on-provided-credential-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Identifies the resource.|
|action|path|string|true|Identifies the action to be taken.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|action|activate|
|action|deactivate|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "created_at": "2020-06-18T21:32:38",
    "expired": "false",
    "expires_at": "2042-06-18T21:32:38",
    "id": "c215ade3-0d39-418e-94be-c5f780760199",
    "name": "2020-06-18 21:32:38.917732Z",
    "record_type": "credential",
    "resource_id": "connection:804252963366242252",
    "sip_password": "a92dbcfb60184a8cb330b0acb2f7617b",
    "sip_username": "gencrednCvHU5IYpSBPPsXI2iQsDX",
    "updated_at": "2020-06-18T21:32:38.000Z",
    "user_id": "user-id"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="perform-activate-or-deactivate-action-on-provided-credential-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response with details about a credential|Inline|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-debugging">Debugging</h1>

Call Control debugging

## List call events

<a id="opIdlistCallEvents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/call_events \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /call_events`

Filters call events by given filter parameters. Events are ordered by `event_timestamp`. If filter for `call_leg_id` or `call_session_id` is not present, it only filters events from the last 24 hours.

**Note**: Only one `filter[event_timestamp]` can be passed.


<h3 id="list-call-events-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filter[call_leg_id]|query|string(uuid)|false|The unique identifier of an individual call leg.|
|filter[call_session_id]|query|string(uuid)|false|The unique identifier of the call control session. A session may include multiple call leg events.|
|filter[status]|query|string|false|Event status|
|filter[type]|query|string|false|Event type|
|filter[event_timestamp][gt]|query|string|false|Event timestamp: greater than|
|filter[event_timestamp][gte]|query|string|false|Event timestamp: greater than or equal|
|filter[event_timestamp][lt]|query|string|false|Event timestamp: lower than|
|filter[event_timestamp][lte]|query|string|false|Event timestamp: lower than or equal|
|filter[event_timestamp][eq]|query|string|false|Event timestamp: equal|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|filter[status]|delivered|
|filter[status]|failed|
|filter[type]|command|
|filter[type]|webhook|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "call_leg_id": "308fe500-5213-11e9-ace7-02420a0f0668",
      "call_session_id": "308fec30-5213-11e9-9d3f-02420a0f0668",
      "event_timestamp": "2019-03-29T11:10:19.127783Z",
      "metadata": {},
      "name": "call.hangup",
      "record_type": "call_event",
      "type": "webhook"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page_number": 2,
    "page_size": 25,
    "total_pages": 3,
    "total_results": 55
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "detail": "string",
      "meta": {},
      "source": {
        "parameter": "string",
        "pointer": "string"
      },
      "title": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-call-events-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response with a list of call events.|Inline|
|default|Default|Unexpected error|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|

<h3 id="list-call-events-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[[CallEvent](#schemacallevent)]|false|none|none|
|meta|[PaginationMeta](#schemapaginationmeta)|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
BearerAuth
</aside>

## List FQDN connections

`GET /fqdn_connections`

Returns a list of your FQDN connections.

<h3 id="list-fqdn-connections-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|
|filter[connection_name][contains]|query|string|false|If present, connections with <code>connection_name</code> containing the given value will be returned. Matching is not case-sensitive. Requires at least three characters.|
|sort|query|string|false|Specifies the sort order for results. By default sorting direction is ascending. To have the results sorted in descending order add the <code> -</code> prefix.<br/><br/><br>That is: <ul><br>  <li><br>    <code>connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in ascending order.<br>  </li><br><br>  <li><br>    <code>-connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in descending order.<br>  </li><br></ul> <br/> If not given, results are sorted by <code>created_at</code> in descending order.|

|sort|created_at|
|sort|connection_name|
|sort|active|

## Create an FQDN connection

<a id="opIdcreateFqdnConnection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/fqdn_connections \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "active": true,
    "anchorsite_override": "Latency",
    "connection_name": "string",
    "default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled": true,
    "dtmf_type": "RFC 2833",
    "encode_contact_header_enabled": true,
    "encrypted_media": "SRTP",
    "inbound": {
      "ani_number_format": "+E.164",
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "codecs": [
        "G722"
      ],
      "default_routing_method": "sequential",
      "dnis_number_format": "+e164",
      "generate_ringback_tone": true,
      "isup_headers_enabled": true,
      "prack_enabled": true,
      "privacy_zone_enabled": true,
      "sip_compact_headers_enabled": true,
      "sip_region": "US",
      "sip_subdomain": "string",
      "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections",
      "timeout_1xx_secs": 10,
      "timeout_2xx_secs": 10
    },
    "onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled": true,
    "rtcp_settings": {
      "capture_enabled": true,
      "port": "rtcp-mux",
      "report_frequency_secs": 10
    },
    "transport_protocol": "UDP",
    "webhook_api_version": "1",
    "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
    "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
    "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
  }'
```

`POST /fqdn_connections`

Creates a FQDN connection.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "active": true,
  "anchorsite_override": "Latency",
  "connection_name": "string",
  "default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled": true,
  "dtmf_type": "RFC 2833",
  "encode_contact_header_enabled": true,
  "encrypted_media": "SRTP",
  "inbound": {
    "ani_number_format": "+E.164",
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "codecs": [
      "G722"
    ],
    "default_routing_method": "sequential",
    "dnis_number_format": "+e164",
    "generate_ringback_tone": true,
    "isup_headers_enabled": true,
    "prack_enabled": true,
    "privacy_zone_enabled": true,
    "sip_compact_headers_enabled": true,
    "sip_region": "US",
    "sip_subdomain": "string",
    "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections",
    "timeout_1xx_secs": 10,
    "timeout_2xx_secs": 10
  },
  "onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled": true,
  "rtcp_settings": {
    "capture_enabled": true,
    "port": "rtcp-mux",
    "report_frequency_secs": 10
  },
  "transport_protocol": "UDP",
  "webhook_api_version": "1",
  "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
  "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
  "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-fqdn-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateFqdnConnectionRequest](#schemacreatefqdnconnectionrequest)|true|Parameters that can be defined during FQDN connection creation|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Defaults to true|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» connection_name|body|string|true|none|
|» default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, Telnyx will generate comfort noise when you place the call on hold. If disabled, you will need to generate comfort noise or on hold music to avoid RTP timeout.|
|» dtmf_type|body|[DtmfType](#schemadtmftype)|false|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|» encode_contact_header_enabled|body|boolean|false|Encode the SIP contact header sent by Telnyx to avoid issues for NAT or ALG scenarios.|
|» encrypted_media|body|[EncryptedMedia](#schemaencryptedmedia)|false|Enable use of SRTP or ZRTP for encryption. Valid values are those listed or null. Cannot be set to non-null if the transport_portocol is TLS.|
|» inbound|body|[InboundFqdn](#schemainboundfqdn)|false|none|
|» onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled|body|boolean|false|Enable on-net T38 if you prefer the sender and receiver negotiating T38 directly if both are on the Telnyx network. If this is disabled, Telnyx will be able to use T38 on just one leg of the call depending on each leg's settings.|
|» rtcp_settings|body|[ConnectionRtcpSettings](#schemaconnectionrtcpsettings)|false|none|
|» transport_protocol|body|[FqdnConnectionTransportProtocol](#schemafqdnconnectiontransportprotocol)|false|One of UDP, TLS, or TCP. Applies only to connections with IP authentication or FQDN authentication.|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1 or v2.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string(url) \| null|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(url)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer \| null|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» anchorsite_override|Latency|
|» anchorsite_override|Chicago, IL|
|» anchorsite_override|Ashburn, VA|
|» anchorsite_override|San Jose, CA|
|» anchorsite_override|Sydney, Australia|
|» anchorsite_override|Amsterdam, Netherlands|
|» anchorsite_override|London, UK|
|» anchorsite_override|Toronto, Canada|
|» anchorsite_override|Vancouver, Canada|
|» anchorsite_override|Frankfurt, Germany|
|» dtmf_type|RFC 2833|
|» dtmf_type|Inband|
|» dtmf_type|SIP INFO|
|» encrypted_media|SRTP|
|» encrypted_media|ZRTP|
|» transport_protocol|UDP|
|» transport_protocol|TCP|
|» transport_protocol|TLS|
|» webhook_api_version|1|
|» webhook_api_version|2|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
```

`PATCH /fqdn_connections/{id}`

Updates settings of an existing FQDN connection.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "active": true,
  "anchorsite_override": "Latency",
  "connection_name": "string",
  "default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled": true,
  "dtmf_type": "RFC 2833",
  "encode_contact_header_enabled": true,
  "encrypted_media": "SRTP",
  "inbound": {
    "ani_number_format": "+E.164",
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "codecs": [
      "G722"
    ],
    "default_routing_method": "sequential",
    "dnis_number_format": "+e164",
    "generate_ringback_tone": true,
    "isup_headers_enabled": true,
    "prack_enabled": true,
    "privacy_zone_enabled": true,
    "sip_compact_headers_enabled": true,
    "sip_region": "US",
    "sip_subdomain": "string",
    "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections",
    "timeout_1xx_secs": 10,
    "timeout_2xx_secs": 10
  },

  "rtcp_settings": {
    "capture_enabled": true,
    "port": "rtcp-mux",
    "report_frequency_secs": 10
  },
  "transport_protocol": "UDP",
  "webhook_api_version": "1",
  "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
  "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
  "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-fqdn-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|FQDN Connection ID|
|body|body|[UpdateFqdnConnectionRequest](#schemaupdatefqdnconnectionrequest)|true|Parameters that can be updated in a FQDN connection|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Defaults to true|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» connection_name|body|string|false|none|
|» default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, Telnyx will generate comfort noise when you place the call on hold. If disabled, you will need to generate comfort noise or on hold music to avoid RTP timeout.|
|» dtmf_type|body|[DtmfType](#schemadtmftype)|false|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|» encode_contact_header_enabled|body|boolean|false|Encode the SIP contact header sent by Telnyx to avoid issues for NAT or ALG scenarios.|
|» encrypted_media|body|[EncryptedMedia](#schemaencryptedmedia)|false|Enable use of SRTP or ZRTP for encryption. Valid values are those listed or null. Cannot be set to non-null if the transport_portocol is TLS.|
|» inbound|body|[InboundFqdn](#schemainboundfqdn)|false|none|
|» onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled|body|boolean|false|Enable on-net T38 if you prefer that the sender and receiver negotiate T38 directly when both are on the Telnyx network. If this is disabled, Telnyx will be able to use T38 on just one leg of the call according to each leg's settings.|
|» rtcp_settings|body|[ConnectionRtcpSettings](#schemaconnectionrtcpsettings)|false|none|
|» transport_protocol|body|[FqdnConnectionTransportProtocol](#schemafqdnconnectiontransportprotocol)|false|One of UDP, TLS, or TCP. Applies only to connections with IP authentication or FQDN authentication.|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1 or v2.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string(url) \| null|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(url)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer \| null|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» anchorsite_override|Latency|
|» anchorsite_override|Chicago, IL|
|» anchorsite_override|Ashburn, VA|
|» anchorsite_override|San Jose, CA|
|» anchorsite_override|Sydney, Australia|
|» anchorsite_override|Amsterdam, Netherlands|
|» anchorsite_override|London, UK|
|» anchorsite_override|Toronto, Canada|
|» anchorsite_override|Vancouver, Canada|
|» anchorsite_override|Frankfurt, Germany|
|» dtmf_type|RFC 2833|
|» dtmf_type|Inband|
|» dtmf_type|SIP INFO|
|» encrypted_media|SRTP|
|» encrypted_media|ZRTP|
|» transport_protocol|UDP|
|» transport_protocol|TCP|
|» transport_protocol|TLS|
|» webhook_api_version|1|
|» webhook_api_version|2|

## List Ip connections

<a id="opIdlistIpConnections"></a>

`GET /ip_connections`

Returns a list of your IP connections.

<h3 id="list-ip-connections-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|
|filter[connection_name][contains]|query|string|false|If present, connections with <code>connection_name</code> containing the given value will be returned. Matching is not case-sensitive. Requires at least three characters.|
|filter[outbound.outbound_voice_profile_id]|query|string(int64)|false|Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.|
|sort|query|string|false|Specifies the sort order for results. By default sorting direction is ascending. To have the results sorted in descending order add the <code> -</code> prefix.<br/><br/><br>That is: <ul><br>  <li><br>    <code>connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in ascending order.<br>  </li><br><br>  <li><br>    <code>-connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in descending order.<br>  </li><br></ul> <br/> If not given, results are sorted by <code>created_at</code> in descending order.|

```json
    },

      "channel_limit": 10,

      "instant_ringback_enabled": true,
      "ip_authentication_method": "token",
      "ip_authentication_token": "string",
      "localization": "string",
```

```bash
    "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
  }'
```

<h3 id="create-an-ip-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateIpConnectionRequest](#schemacreateipconnectionrequest)|true|Parameters that can be defined during IP connection creation|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Defaults to true|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» connection_name|body|string|false|none|
|» default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, Telnyx will generate comfort noise when you place the call on hold. If disabled, you will need to generate comfort noise or on hold music to avoid RTP timeout.|
|» dtmf_type|body|[DtmfType](#schemadtmftype)|false|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|» encode_contact_header_enabled|body|boolean|false|Encode the SIP contact header sent by Telnyx to avoid issues for NAT or ALG scenarios.|
|» encrypted_media|body|[EncryptedMedia](#schemaencryptedmedia)|false|Enable use of SRTP or ZRTP for encryption. Valid values are those listed or null. Cannot be set to non-null if the transport_portocol is TLS.|
|» inbound|body|[CreateInboundIpRequest](#schemacreateinboundiprequest)|false|none|
|» onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled|body|boolean|false|Enable on-net T38 if you prefer the sender and receiver negotiating T38 directly if both are on the Telnyx network. If this is disabled, Telnyx will be able to use T38 on just one leg of the call depending on each leg's settings.|
|» outbound|body|[OutboundIp](#schemaoutboundip)|false|none|
|» rtcp_settings|body|[ConnectionRtcpSettings](#schemaconnectionrtcpsettings)|false|none|
|» transport_protocol|body|string|false|One of UDP, TLS, or TCP. Applies only to connections with IP authentication or FQDN authentication.|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1 or v2.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string(url) \| null|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(url)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer \| null|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|

|---|---|
|» anchorsite_override|Latency|
|» anchorsite_override|Chicago, IL|

|» anchorsite_override|San Jose, CA|

|» webhook_api_version|2|


<h3 id="update-an-ip-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Identifies the type of resource.|
|body|body|[UpdateIpConnectionRequest](#schemaupdateipconnectionrequest)|true|Parameters that can be updated in a IP connection|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Defaults to true|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» connection_name|body|string|false|none|
|» default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, Telnyx will generate comfort noise when you place the call on hold. If disabled, you will need to generate comfort noise or on hold music to avoid RTP timeout.|
|» dtmf_type|body|[DtmfType](#schemadtmftype)|false|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|» encode_contact_header_enabled|body|boolean|false|Encode the SIP contact header sent by Telnyx to avoid issues for NAT or ALG scenarios.|
|» encrypted_media|body|[EncryptedMedia](#schemaencryptedmedia)|false|Enable use of SRTP or ZRTP for encryption. Valid values are those listed or null. Cannot be set to non-null if the transport_portocol is TLS.|
|» inbound|body|[InboundIp](#schemainboundip)|false|none|
|» onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled|body|boolean|false|Enable on-net T38 if you prefer the sender and receiver negotiating T38 directly if both are on the Telnyx network. If this is disabled, Telnyx will be able to use T38 on just one leg of the call depending on each leg's settings.|
|» outbound|body|[OutboundIp](#schemaoutboundip)|false|none|
|» rtcp_settings|body|[ConnectionRtcpSettings](#schemaconnectionrtcpsettings)|false|none|
|» transport_protocol|body|string|false|One of UDP, TLS, or TCP. Applies only to connections with IP authentication or FQDN authentication.|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1 or v2.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string(url) \| null|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(url)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer \| null|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|

|---|---|

|» anchorsite_override|Chicago, IL|
|» anchorsite_override|Ashburn, VA|
|» anchorsite_override|San Jose, CA|

|» encrypted_media|ZRTP|
|» transport_protocol|UDP|
|» transport_protocol|TCP|
|» transport_protocol|TLS|
|» webhook_api_version|1|
|» webhook_api_version|2|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-managed-accounts">Managed Accounts</h1>

Managed Accounts operations

## Lists accounts managed by the current user.

<a id="opIdlistManagedAccounts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/managed_accounts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /managed_accounts`

Lists the accounts managed by the current user. Users need to be explictly approved by Telnyx in order to become manager accounts.

<h3 id="lists-accounts-managed-by-the-current-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|
|filter[email][contains]|query|string|false|If present, email containing the given value will be returned. Matching is not case-sensitive. Requires at least three characters.|
|filter[email][eq]|query|string|false|If present, only returns results with the <code>email</code> matching exactly the value given.|
|sort|query|string|false|Specifies the sort order for results. By default sorting direction is ascending. To have the results sorted in descending order add the <code> -</code> prefix.<br/><br/><br>That is: <ul><br>  <li><br>    <code>email</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>email</code> field in ascending order.<br>  </li><br><br>  <li><br>    <code>-email</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>email</code> field in descending order.<br>  </li><br></ul> <br/> If not given, results are sorted by <code>created_at</code> in descending order.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort|created_at|
|sort|email|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "api_key": "KEY0174227C1D16D1B180A8FF742AD37F70_1bA4vlJKHpZcJGaSXaadFu",
      "api_token": "x6oexQNHTs-fZ7-QsDMOeg",
      "api_user": "managed_account@example.com",
      "balance": {
        "available_credit": "400.00",
        "balance": "300.00",
        "credit_limit": "100.00",
        "currency": "USD",
        "record_type": "balance"
      },
      "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "id": "f65ceda4-6522-4ad6-aede-98de83385123",
      "manager_account_id": "f65ceda4-6522-4ad6-aede-98de83385123",
      "organization_name": "Example Company LLC",
      "record_type": "managed_account",
      "updated_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page_number": 2,
    "page_size": 25,
    "total_pages": 3,
    "total_results": 55
  }
}
```

## Create a new managed account.

<a id="opIdcreateManagedAccount"></a>

```bash
curl https://example.com/managed_accounts \
```

`POST /managed_accounts`

Create a new managed account owned by the authenticated user. You need to be explictly approved by Telnyx in order to become a manager account.

```json
{

  "email": "larry_cat_food@customer.org",
```

<h1 id="telnyx-api-messages">Messages</h1>

Messages

## Send a message

<a id="opIdcreateMessage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/messages \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "from": "+18445550001",
    "media_urls": [
      "http://example.com"
    ],
    "messaging_profile_id": "abc85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c9600000000",
    "subject": "From Telnyx!",
    "text": "Hello, World!",
    "to": "+18445550001",
    "type": "MMS",
    "use_profile_webhooks": true,
    "webhook_failover_url": "https://backup.example.com/hooks",
    "webhook_url": "http://example.com/webhooks"
  }'
```

`POST /messages`

Send a message with a Phone Number, Alphanumeric Sender ID, Short Code or Number Pool.

This endpoint allows you to send a message with any messaging resource.
Current messaging resources include: long-code, short-code, number-pool, and
alphanumeric-sender-id.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "from": "+18445550001",
  "media_urls": [
    "http://example.com"
  ],
  "messaging_profile_id": "abc85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c9600000000",
  "subject": "From Telnyx!",
  "text": "Hello, World!",
  "to": "+18445550001",
  "type": "MMS",
  "use_profile_webhooks": true,
  "webhook_failover_url": "https://backup.example.com/hooks",
  "webhook_url": "http://example.com/webhooks"
}
```

<h3 id="send-a-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateMessageRequest](#schemacreatemessagerequest)|false|Message payload|
|» auto_detect|body|boolean|false|Automatically detect if an SMS message is unusually long and exceeds a recommended limit of message parts.|
|» from|body|string(address)|false|Sending address (+E.164 formatted phone number, alphanumeric sender ID, or short code).<br><br>**Required if sending with a phone number, short code, or alphanumeric sender ID.**<br>|
|» media_urls|body|[string(url)]|false|A list of media URLs. The total media size must be less than 1 MB.<br><br>**Required for MMS**|
|» messaging_profile_id|body|string|false|Unique identifier for a messaging profile.<br><br>**Required if sending via number pool or with an alphanumeric sender ID.**<br>|
|» subject|body|string|false|Subject of multimedia message|
|» text|body|string|false|Message body (i.e., content) as a non-empty string.<br><br>**Required for SMS**|
|» to|body|[ToNumber](#schematonumber)|true|Receiving address (+E.164 formatted phone number or short code).|
|» type|body|string|false|The protocol for sending the message, either SMS or MMS.|
|» use_profile_webhooks|body|boolean|false|If the profile this number is associated with has webhooks, use them for delivery notifications. If webhooks are also specified on the message itself, they will be attempted first, then those on the profile.|
|» webhook_failover_url|body|string(url)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this message will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails.|
|» webhook_url|body|string(url)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this message will be sent.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|SMS|
|» type|MMS|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "completed_at": null,
    "cost": null,
    "direction": "outbound",
    "encoding": "GSM-7",
    "errors": [],
    "from": {
      "carrier": "TELNYX LLC",
      "line_type": "VoIP",
      "phone_number": "+18445550001"
    },
    "id": "40385f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
    "media": [
      {
        "content_type": null,
        "sha256": null,
        "size": null,
        "url": "https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1142168442042118144/AW3F4fFD_400x400.png"
      }
    ],
    "messaging_profile_id": "4000eba1-a0c0-4563-9925-b25e842a7cb6",
    "organization_id": "b448f9cc-a842-4784-98e9-03c1a5872950",
    "parts": 1,
    "received_at": "2019-01-23T18:10:02.574Z",
    "record_type": "message",
    "sent_at": null,
    "subject": "From Telnyx!",
    "tags": [
      "Greetings"
    ],
    "text": "Hello, World!",

        "status": "queued"

    "valid_until": null,
    "webhook_failover_url": "https://backup.example.com/hooks",
    "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/hooks"
  }
}
```

```json
}
```

```bash
curl https://example.com/messaging_hosted_number_orders/string/actions/file_upload \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \

  -F 'loa=@/path/to/file'
```

```json
    },
```
```json
    "webhook_api_version": "2",
    "webhook_failover_url": "https://backup.example.com/hooks",
```
```bash
    "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/hooks"
  }'
```

|» number_pool_settings|body|[NumberPoolSettings](#schemanumberpoolsettings)|false|Number Pool allows you to send messages from a pool of numbers of different types, assigning<br>weights to each type. |» url_shortener_settings|body|[UrlShortenerSettings](#schemaurlshortenersettings)|false|The URL shortener feature allows automatic replacement of URLs that were generated using<br>a public URL shortener service. Some examples include bit.do, bit.ly, goo.gl, ht.ly,<br>is.gd, ow.ly, rebrand.ly, t.co, tiny.cc, and tinyurl.com. Such URLs are replaced with<br>with links generated by Telnyx. The use of custom links can improve branding and message<br>deliverability.<br><br>To disable this feature, set the object field to `null`.<br>|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1, v2, or a legacy 2010-04-01 format.|
|» webhook_failover_url|body|string(url) \| null|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this messaging profile will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails.|
|» webhook_url|body|string(url) \| null|false|The URL where webhooks related to this messaging profile will be sent.|


`GET /mobile_operator_networks`

Telnyx has a set of GSM mobile operators partners that are available through our mobile network roaming. This resource is entirely managed by Telnyx and may change over time. That means that this resource won't allow any write operations for it. Still, it's available so it can be used as a support resource that can be related to other resources or become a configuration option.

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone_numbers/jobs/update_phone_numbers \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

  -d '{
    "billing_group_id": "dc8e4d67-33a0-4cbb-af74-7b58f05bd494",

    "customer_reference": "customer-reference",
    "external_pin": "123456",

      "+13127367254"
    ],
    "tags": [
      "tag"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /phone_numbers/jobs/update_phone_numbers`

Creates a new background job to update a batch of numbers. At most one thousand numbers can be updated per API call. At least one of the updateable fields must be submitted.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "billing_group_id": "dc8e4d67-33a0-4cbb-af74-7b58f05bd494",
  "connection_id": "dc8e4d67-33a0-4cbb-af74-7b58f05bd494",
  "customer_reference": "customer-reference",
  "external_pin": "123456",
  "phone_numbers": [
    "1583466971586889004",
    "+13127367254"
  ],
  "tags": [
    "tag"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-batch-of-numbers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PhoneNumbersJobUpdatePhoneNumbersRequest](#schemaphonenumbersjobupdatephonenumbersrequest)|true|none|
|» billing_group_id|body|string|false|Identifies the billing group associated with the phone number.|
|» connection_id|body|string|false|Identifies the connection associated with the phone number.|
|» customer_reference|body|string|false|A customer reference string for customer look ups.|
|» external_pin|body|string|false|If someone attempts to port your phone number away from Telnyx and your phone number has an external PIN set, we will attempt to verify that you provided the correct external PIN to the winning carrier. Note that not all carriers cooperate with this security mechanism.|
|» phone_numbers|body|[string]|true|Array of phone number ids and/or phone numbers in E164 format to update|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|A list of user-assigned tags to help organize phone numbers.|

## Deletes all numbers associated with a phone number block

<a id="opIdcreatePhoneNumberBlocksJobDeletePhoneNumberBlock"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone_number_blocks/jobs/delete_phone_number_block \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "phone_number_block_id": "f3946371-7199-4261-9c3d-81a0d7935146"
  }'
```

`POST /phone_number_blocks/jobs/delete_phone_number_block`

Creates a new background job to delete all the phone numbers associated with the given block. We will only consider the phone number block as deleted after all phone numbers associated with it are removed, so multiple executions of this job may be necessary in case some of the phone numbers present errors during the deletion process.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "phone_number_block_id": "f3946371-7199-4261-9c3d-81a0d7935146"
}
```

<h3 id="deletes-all-numbers-associated-with-a-phone-number-block-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PhoneNumberBlocksJobDeletePhoneNumberBlockRequest](#schemaphonenumberblocksjobdeletephonenumberblockrequest)|true|none|
|» phone_number_block_id|body|string|true|none|

<a id="opIdNumberLookup"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/number_lookup/%2B18665552368 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /number_lookup/{phone_number}`

Returns information about the provided phone number.

<h3 id="lookup-phone-number-data-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|phone_number|path|string|true|The phone number to be looked up|
|type|query|string|false|Specifies the type of number lookup to be performed|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|carrier|
|type|caller-name|

```json
      "city": "WAUKEGAN",
```

## List number order documents

<a id="opIdlistNumberOrderDocuments"></a>

`GET /number_order_documents`

Gets a paginated list of number order documents.

<h3 id="list-number-order-documents-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filter[requirement_id]|query|string|false|Filter number order documents by `requirement_id`.|
|filter[created_at][gt]|query|string|false|Filter number order documents after this datetime.|
|filter[created_at][lt]|query|string|false|Filter number order documents from before this datetime.|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "created_at": "2018-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z",
      "customer_reference": "MY REF 001",
      "file_id": "1e3c5822-0362-4702-8e46-5a129f0d3976",
      "id": "387d1e31-a218-4375-8151-103f2d5e2d2c",
      "record_type": "number_order_document",
      "requirement_type": "address_proof",
      "requirements_id": "36aaf27d-986b-493c-bd1b-de16af2e4292"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page_number": 2,
    "page_size": 25,
    "total_pages": 3,
    "total_results": 55
  }
}
```

```json
{

    {
      "code": "string",
      "detail": "string",
      "meta": {},
      "source": {
        "parameter": "string",
        "pointer": "string"
      },
      "title": "string"
    }
```
```json
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-outbound-voice-profile-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|» billing_group_id|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|The ID of the billing group associated with the outbound proflile. Defaults to null (for no group assigned).|
|» call_recording|body|[OutboundCallRecording](#schemaoutboundcallrecording)|false|none|

|» daily_spend_limit_enabled|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether to enforce the daily_spend_limit on this outbound voice profile.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether the outbound voice profile can be used. Disabled profiles will result in outbound calls being blocked for the associated Connections.|
|» max_destination_rate|body|number|false|Maximum rate (price per minute) for a Destination to be allowed when making outbound calls.|
|» name|body|string|true|A user-supplied name to help with organization.|
|» service_plan|body|[ServicePlan](#schemaserviceplan)|false|Indicates the coverage of the termination regions. International and Global are the same but International may only be used for high volume/short duration Outbound Voice Profiles.|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|none|
|» traffic_type|body|[TrafficType](#schematraffictype)|false|Specifies the type of traffic allowed in this profile.|
|» usage_payment_method|body|[UsagePaymentMethod](#schemausagepaymentmethod)|false|Setting for how costs for outbound profile are calculated.|
|» whitelisted_destinations|body|[string]|false|The list of destinations you want to be able to call using this outbound voice profile formatted in alpha2.|

```bash
curl https://example.com/portability_checks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{

      "+13035550002"
```

`GET /porting_orders`

Returns a list of your porting order.

<h3 id="list-all-porting-orders-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|

|filter[phone_numbers][country_code]|query|string|false|Filter results by country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code|
|filter[phone_numbers][carrier_name]|query|string|false|Filter results by old service provider|
|filter[misc][type]|query|[PortingOrderType](#schemaportingordertype)|false|Filter results by porting order type|
|filter[end_user][admin][entity_name]|query|string|false|Filter results by person or company name|
|filter[end_user][admin][auth_person_name]|query|string|false|Filter results by authorized person|
|filter[activation_settings][fast_port_eligible]|query|boolean|false|Filter results by fast port eligible|
|filter[activation_settings][foc_datetime_requested][gt]|query|string|false|Filter results by foc date later than this value|
|filter[activation_settings][foc_datetime_requested][lt]|query|string|false|Filter results by foc date earlier than this value|
|sort|query|string|false|Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|filter[misc][type]|full|
|filter[misc][type]|partial|
|sort|created_at|
|sort|-created_at|
|sort|activation_settings.foc_datetime_requested|
|sort|-activation_settings.foc_datetime_requested|

`PATCH /porting_orders/{id}`

Edits the details of an existing porting order.

Any or all of a porting order’s attributes may be included in the resource object included in a PATCH request.

If a request does not include all of the attributes for a resource, the system will interpret the missing attributes as if they were included with their current values. To explicitly set something to null, it must be included in the request with a null value.

## List all porting phone numbers

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/porting_phone_numbers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /porting_phone_numbers`

Returns a list of your porting phone numbers.

<h3 id="list-all-porting-phone-numbers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|
|filter[porting_order_id]|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter results by porting order id|
|filter[phone_number]|query|string|false|Filter results by phone number|
|filter[activation_status]|query|[ActivationStatus](#schemaactivationstatus)|false|Filter results by activation status|
|filter[portability_status]|query|[PortabilityStatus](#schemaportabilitystatus)|false|Filter results by portability status|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|filter[activation_status]|New|
|filter[activation_status]|Pending|
|filter[activation_status]|Conflict|
|filter[activation_status]|Cancel Pending|
|filter[activation_status]|Failed|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-programmable-fax-applications">Programmable Fax Applications</h1>

Fax Applications operations

## List all Fax Applications

<a id="opIdlistFaxApplications"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/fax_applications \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /fax_applications`

This endpoint returns a list of your Fax Applications inside the 'data' attribute of the response. You can adjust which applications are listed by using filters. Fax Applications are used to configure how you send and receive faxes using the Programmable Fax API with Telnyx.

<h3 id="list-all-fax-applications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|
|filter[application_name][contains]|query|string|false|If present, applications with <code>application_name</code> containing the given value will be returned. Matching is not case-sensitive. Requires at least three characters.|
|filter[outbound_voice_profile_id]|query|string(int64)|false|Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.|
|sort|query|string|false|Specifies the sort order for results. By default sorting direction is ascending. To have the results sorted in descending order add the <code> -</code> prefix.<br/><br/><br>That is: <ul><br>  <li><br>    <code>connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in ascending order.<br>  </li><br><br>  <li><br>    <code>-connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in descending order.<br>  </li><br></ul> <br/> If not given, results are sorted by <code>created_at</code> in descending order.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort|created_at|
|sort|connection_name|
|sort|active|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "active": false,
      "anchorsite_override": "Amsterdam, Netherlands",
      "application_name": "fax-router",
      "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
      "id": "1293384261075731499",
      "inbound": {
        "channel_limit": 10,
        "sip_subdomain": "example",
        "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
      },
      "outbound": {
        "channel_limit": 10,
        "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
      },
      "record_type": "fax_application",
      "updated_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
      "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
      "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
      "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page_number": 2,
    "page_size": 25,
    "total_pages": 3,
    "total_results": 55
  }
}
```

## Creates a Fax Application

<a id="opIdCreateFaxApplication"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/fax_applications \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "active": false,
    "anchorsite_override": "Amsterdam, Netherlands",
    "application_name": "fax-router",
    "inbound": {
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "sip_subdomain": "example",
      "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
    },
    "outbound": {
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
    },
    "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
    "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
    "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
  }'
```

`POST /fax_applications`

Creates a new Fax Application based on the parameters sent in the request. The application name and webhook URL are required. Once created, you can assign phone numbers to your application using the `/phone_numbers` endpoint.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "active": false,
  "anchorsite_override": "Amsterdam, Netherlands",
  "application_name": "fax-router",
  "inbound": {
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "sip_subdomain": "example",
    "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
  },
  "outbound": {
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
  },
  "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
  "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
  "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-fax-application-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateFaxApplicationRequest](#schemacreatefaxapplicationrequest)|true|Parameters that can be set when creating a Fax Application|
|» active|body|[ConnectionActive](#schemaconnectionactive)|false|Specifies whether the connection can be used.|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» application_name|body|[ApplicationName](#schemaapplicationname)|true|A user-assigned name to help manage the application.|
|» inbound|body|object|false|none|
|» » channel_limit|body|integer|false|When set, this will limit the number of concurrent inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|» » sip_subdomain|body|string|false|Specifies a subdomain that can be used to receive Inbound calls to a Connection, in the same way a phone number is used, from a SIP endpoint. Example: the subdomain "example.sip.telnyx.com" can be called from any SIP endpoint by using the SIP URI "sip:@example.sip.telnyx.com" where the user part can be any alphanumeric value. Please note TLS encrypted calls are not allowed for subdomain calls.|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|body|string|false|This option can be enabled to receive calls from: "Anyone" (any SIP endpoint in the public Internet) or "Only my connections" (any connection assigned to the same Telnyx user).|
|» outbound|body|object|false|none|
|» » channel_limit|body|integer|false|When set, this will limit the number of concurrent outbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|» » outbound_voice_profile_id|body|[OutboundVoiceProfileId](#schemaoutboundvoiceprofileid)|false|Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|[WebhookEventFailoverUrl](#schemawebhookeventfailoverurl)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|[WebhookEventUrl](#schemawebhookeventurl)|true|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|[WebhookTimeoutSecs](#schemawebhooktimeoutsecs)|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» anchorsite_override|Latency|
|» anchorsite_override|Chicago, IL|
|» anchorsite_override|Ashburn, VA|
|» anchorsite_override|San Jose, CA|
|» anchorsite_override|Sydney, Australia|
|» anchorsite_override|Amsterdam, Netherlands|
|» anchorsite_override|London, UK|
|» anchorsite_override|Toronto, Canada|
|» anchorsite_override|Vancouver, Canada|
|» anchorsite_override|Frankfurt, Germany|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|only_my_connections|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|from_anyone|

```json
    "active": false,

    "application_name": "fax-router",
    "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
```

<a id="opIdUpdateFaxApplication"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/fax_applications/1293384261075731499 \

      "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
    },
    "outbound": {
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
    },
    "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
    "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
    "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
  }'
```

`PATCH /fax_applications/{id}`

Updates settings of an existing Fax Application based on the parameters of the request.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "active": false,
  "anchorsite_override": "Amsterdam, Netherlands",
  "application_name": "fax-router",
  "inbound": {
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "sip_subdomain": "example",
    "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
  },
  "outbound": {
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
  },
  "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
  "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
  "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-fax-application-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(int64)|true|Identifies the resource.|
|body|body|[UpdateFaxApplicationRequest](#schemaupdatefaxapplicationrequest)|true|Parameters to be updated for the Fax Application|
|» active|body|[ConnectionActive](#schemaconnectionactive)|false|Specifies whether the connection can be used.|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» application_name|body|[ApplicationName](#schemaapplicationname)|true|A user-assigned name to help manage the application.|
|» inbound|body|object|false|none|
|» » channel_limit|body|integer|false|When set, this will limit the number of concurrent inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|» » sip_subdomain|body|string|false|Specifies a subdomain that can be used to receive Inbound calls to a Connection, in the same way a phone number is used, from a SIP endpoint. Example: the subdomain "example.sip.telnyx.com" can be called from any SIP endpoint by using the SIP URI "sip:@example.sip.telnyx.com" where the user part can be any alphanumeric value. Please note TLS encrypted calls are not allowed for subdomain calls.|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|body|string|false|This option can be enabled to receive calls from: "Anyone" (any SIP endpoint in the public Internet) or "Only my connections" (any connection assigned to the same Telnyx user).|
|» outbound|body|object|false|none|
|» » channel_limit|body|integer|false|When set, this will limit the number of concurrent outbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|» » outbound_voice_profile_id|body|[OutboundVoiceProfileId](#schemaoutboundvoiceprofileid)|false|Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|[WebhookEventFailoverUrl](#schemawebhookeventfailoverurl)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|[WebhookEventUrl](#schemawebhookeventurl)|true|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|[WebhookTimeoutSecs](#schemawebhooktimeoutsecs)|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» anchorsite_override|Latency|
|» anchorsite_override|Chicago, IL|
|» anchorsite_override|Ashburn, VA|
|» anchorsite_override|San Jose, CA|
|» anchorsite_override|Sydney, Australia|
|» anchorsite_override|Amsterdam, Netherlands|
|» anchorsite_override|London, UK|
|» anchorsite_override|Toronto, Canada|
|» anchorsite_override|Vancouver, Canada|
|» anchorsite_override|Frankfurt, Germany|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|only_my_connections|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|from_anyone|

## Send a fax

<a id="opIdSendFax"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/faxes \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "connection_id": "234423",
    "from": "+13125790015",
    "media_name": "my_media_uploaded_to_media_storage_api",
    "media_url": "https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf",
    "quality": "high",
    "store_media": false,
    "to": "+13127367276"
  }'
```

`POST /faxes`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "connection_id": "234423",
  "from": "+13125790015",
  "media_name": "my_media_uploaded_to_media_storage_api",
  "media_url": "https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf",
  "quality": "high",
  "store_media": false,
  "to": "+13127367276"
}
```

<h3 id="send-a-fax-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SendFaxRequest](#schemasendfaxrequest)|true|Send fax request|
|» connection_id|body|string|true|The connection ID to send the fax with.|
|» from|body|string|true|The phone number, in E.164 format, the fax will be sent from.|
|» media_name|body|string|false|The media_name of a file to be used for the fax's media. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. media_url and media_name can't be submitted together.|
|» media_url|body|string|false|The URL to the PDF used for the fax's media. media_url and media_name can't be submitted together.|
|» quality|body|string|false|The quality of the fax. Can be normal, high, very_high.|
|» store_media|body|boolean|false|Should fax media be stored on temporary URL. It does not support media_name, they can't be submitted together.|
|» to|body|string|true|The phone number, in E.164 format, the fax will be sent to or SIP URI.|

```json
    "status": "queued",

    "to": "+456",
    "updated_at": "2020-05-05T09:59:12",
    "webhook_failover_url": "",
    "webhook_url": "http://www.example.com/webhooks"
  }
}
```

## Create a Wireless Detail Records (WDRs) Report

<a id="opIdcreateWdrReport"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/wireless/detail_records_reports \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "end_time": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
    "start_time": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z"
  }'
```

`POST /wireless/detail_records_reports`

Asynchronously create a report containing Wireless Detail Records (WDRs) for the SIM cards that consumed wireless data in the given time period.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "end_time": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
  "start_time": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-wireless-detail-records-wdrs-report-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[WdrReportRequest](#schemawdrreportrequest)|true|none|
|» end_time|body|string|false|ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating the end time.|
|» start_time|body|string|false|ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating the start time.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
    "end_time": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
    "id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
    "record_type": "detail_records_report",
    "report_url": "http://example.com",
    "start_time": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
    "status": "pending",
    "updated_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z"
  }
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "detail": "string",
      "meta": {},
      "source": {
        "parameter": "string",
        "pointer": "string"
      },
      "title": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "detail": "string",
      "meta": {},
      "source": {
        "parameter": "string",
        "pointer": "string"
      },
      "title": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-wireless-detail-records-wdrs-report-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful response|Inline|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity. Check the 'detail' field in response for details.|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|
|default|Default|Unexpected error|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|

<h3 id="create-a-wireless-detail-records-wdrs-report-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms \
```

`POST /rooms`

Synchronously create a Room.

> Body parameter

```json

  "unique_name": "My room"
```
