<h1 id="telnyx-api-rooms-client-tokens">Rooms Client Tokens</h1>

Rooms Client Tokens operations.

## Create Client Token to join a room.

<a id="opIdCreateRoomClientToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/0ccc7b54-4df3-4bca-a65a-3da1ecc777f0/actions/generate_join_client_token \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "refresh_token_ttl_secs": 3600,
    "token_ttl_secs": 600
  }'
```

`POST /rooms/{room_id}/actions/generate_join_client_token`

Synchronously create an Client Token to join a Room. Client Token is necessary to join a Telnyx Room. Client Token will expire after `token_ttl_secs`, a Refresh Token is also provided to refresh a Client Token, the Refresh Token expires after `refresh_token_ttl_secs`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "refresh_token_ttl_secs": 3600,
  "token_ttl_secs": 600
}
```

<h3 id="create-client-token-to-join-a-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|room_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of a room.|
|body|body|[CreateRoomClientTokenRequest](#schemacreateroomclienttokenrequest)|true|Parameters that can be defined during Room Client Token creation.|
|» refresh_token_ttl_secs|body|integer|false|The time to live in seconds of the Refresh Token, after that time the Refresh Token is invalid and can't be used to refresh Client Token.|
|» token_ttl_secs|body|integer|false|The time to live in seconds of the Client Token, after that time the Client Token is invalid and can't be used to join a Room.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "refresh_token": "eyJhbGciOiJFZDI1NTE5IiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0..FHsp7KlVXn1E5tTUiKZzmQ4of39gi57AakeQeqI0oAa8hzjFMVb0RGj-mxWTvHVen4GpgsUW_epqqaxK16viCA",
    "refresh_token_expires_at": "2021-04-22T12:15:05Z",
    "token": "eyJhbGciOiJFZDI1NTE5IiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0..1JGK9PyHkTtoP_iMu-8TzXH_fhmnsDtZZOAJLDzLW6DDtAb80wZ93l1VH5yNx5tFqwIFG0t48dRiBKWlW-nzDA",
    "token_expires_at": "2021-04-22T12:24:55Z"
  }
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "code": "string",
  "detail": "string",
  "meta": {},
  "source": {
    "parameter": "string",
    "pointer": "string"
  },
  "title": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-client-token-to-join-a-room-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Create room client token response.|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<h3 id="create-client-token-to-join-a-room-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|object|false|none|none|
|» refresh_token|string(jwt)|false|none|none|
|» refresh_token_expires_at|string(datetime)|false|none|ISO 8601 timestamp when the refresh token expires.|
|» token|string(jwt)|false|none|none|
|» token_expires_at|string(datetime)|false|none|ISO 8601 timestamp when the token expires.|

<aside class="warning">

BearerAuth
</aside>

`POST /sim_card_groups/{id}/actions/remove_private_wireless_gateway`

This action will asynchronously remove an existing Private Wireless Gateway definition from a SIM card group. Completing this operation defines that all SIM cards in the SIM card group will get their traffic handled by Telnyx's default mobile network configuration.

## Request Private Wireless Gateway assignment for SIM card group

<a id="opIdSetSIMCardGroupPrivateWirelessGateway"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/sim_card_groups/6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58/actions/set_private_wireless_gateway \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "private_wireless_gateway_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58"
  }'
```

`POST /sim_card_groups/{id}/actions/set_private_wireless_gateway`

This action will asynchronously assign a provisioned Private Wireless Gateway to the SIM card group. Completing this operation defines that all SIM cards in the SIM card group will get their traffic controlled by the associated Private Wireless Gateway. This operation will also imply that new SIM cards assigned to a group will inherit its network definitions. If it's moved to a different group that doesn't have a Private Wireless Gateway, it'll use Telnyx's default mobile network configuration.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "private_wireless_gateway_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58"
}
```

<h3 id="request-private-wireless-gateway-assignment-for-sim-card-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|Identifies the resource.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» private_wireless_gateway_id|body|string(uuid)|true|The identification of the related Private Wireless Gateway resource.|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
```

`GET /sim_card_orders`

Get all SIM card orders according to filters.

<h3 id="get-all-sim-card-orders-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filter[created_at]|query|string(datetime)|false|Filter by ISO 8601 formatted date-time string matching resource creation date-time.|
|filter[updated_at]|query|string(datetime)|false|Filter by ISO 8601 formatted date-time string matching resource last update date-time.|
|filter[quantity]|query|integer|false|Filter orders by how many SIM cards were ordered.|
|filter[cost.amount]|query|string|false|The total monetary amount of the order.|
|filter[cost.currency]|query|string|false|Filter by ISO 4217 currency string.|
|filter[address.id]|query|string(int64)|false|Uniquely identifies the address for the order.|
|filter[address.street_address]|query|string|false|Returns entries with matching name of the street where the address is located.|
|filter[address.extended_address]|query|string|false|Returns entries with matching name of the supplemental field for address information.|
|filter[address.locality]|query|string|false|Filter by the name of the city where the address is located.|
|filter[address.administrative_area]|query|string|false|Filter by state or province where the address is located.|
|filter[address.country_code]|query|string|false|Filter by the mobile operator two-character (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) origin country code.|
|filter[address.postal_code]|query|string|false|Filter by postal code for the address.|

## Bulk Network Preferences for SIM cards

<a id="opIdBulkSIMCardNetworkPreferences"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/actions/network_preferences/sim_cards \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "mobile_operator_networks_preferences": [
      {
        "mobile_operator_network_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
        "priority": 0
      }
    ],
    "sim_card_ids": [
      "6b14e151-8493-4fa1-8664-1cc4e6d14158",
      "6b14e151-8493-4fa1-8664-1cc4e6d14158"
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /actions/network_preferences/sim_cards`

This API allows dispatching the same operation described for the PUT sim_cards/:sim_card_id/network_preferences API for multiple SIM cards at once.<br/><br/>
Although, a SIM card network preference may fail individually under any validation triggered as a consequence of its state. For example, a SIM can't have an in-progress OTA update for applying a Network Preference, so they'll fail when requested in this API. In that scenario, the specific error will be present in the response along with the successful definitions in the "errors" response node.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "mobile_operator_networks_preferences": [
    {
      "mobile_operator_network_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
      "priority": 0
    }
  ],
  "sim_card_ids": [
    "6b14e151-8493-4fa1-8664-1cc4e6d14158",
    "6b14e151-8493-4fa1-8664-1cc4e6d14158"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="bulk-network-preferences-for-sim-cards-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» mobile_operator_networks_preferences|body|[MobileOperatorNetworksPreferencesRequest](#schemamobileoperatornetworkspreferencesrequest)|false|A list of mobile operator networks and the priority that should be applied when the SIM is connecting to the network.|
|» sim_card_ids|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|

## Register SIM cards

<a id="opIdSimCardRegister"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/actions/register/sim_cards \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "registration_codes": [
      "0000000001",
      "0000000002",
      "0000000003"
    ],
    "sim_card_group_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
    "status": "standby",
    "tags": [
      "personal",
      "customers",
      "active-customers"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /actions/register/sim_cards`

Register the SIM cards associated with the provided registration codes to the current user's account.<br/><br/>
If <code>sim_card_group_id</code> is provided, the SIM cards will be associated with that group. Otherwise, the default group for the current user will be used.<br/><br/>


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "registration_codes": [
    "0000000001",
    "0000000002",
    "0000000003"
  ],
  "sim_card_group_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
  "status": "standby",
  "tags": [
    "personal",
    "customers",
    "active-customers"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="register-sim-cards-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SIMCardRegistration](#schemasimcardregistration)|true|none|
|» registration_codes|body|[string]|true|none|
|» sim_card_group_id|body|string(uuid)|false|The group SIMCardGroup identification. This attribute can be <code>null</code> when it's present in an associated resource.|
|» status|body|string|false|Status on which the SIM card will be set after being successful registered.|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Searchable tags associated with the SIM card|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|enabled|
|» status|disabled|
|» status|standby|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",

      "id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
      "imsi": 81932214823362980,
      "msisdn": "+13109976224",
      "record_type": "sim_card",
      "sim_card_group_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
      "status": "enabled",
      "tags": [
        "personal",
        "customers",
        "active-customers"
      ],
      "updated_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z"
    }
  ],
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "detail": "string",
      "meta": {},
      "source": {
        "parameter": "string",
        "pointer": "string"
      },
      "title": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="register-sim-cards-responses">Responses</h3>

|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Successful response|Inline|

## Get all SIM cards

<a id="opIdSimCardsGet"></a>

`GET /sim_cards`

Get all SIM cards belonging to the user that match the given filters.

<h3 id="get-all-sim-cards-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|
|include_sim_card_group|query|boolean|false|It includes the associated SIM card group object in the response when present.|
|filter[sim_card_group_id]|query|string(uuid)|false|A valid SIM card group ID.|
|filter[tags]|query|[string]|false|A list of SIM card tags to filter on.<br/><br/><br>If the SIM card contains <b><i>all</i></b> of the given <code>tags</code> they will be found.<br/><br/><br>For example, if the SIM cards have the following tags: <ul><br>  <li><code>['customers', 'staff', 'test']</code><br>  <li><code>['test']</code></li><br>  <li><code>['customers']</code></li><br></ul><br>Searching for <code>['customers', 'test']</code> returns only the first because it's the only one with both tags.<br/> Searching for <code>test</code> returns the first two SIMs, because both of them have such tag.<br/> Searching for <code>customers</code> returns the first and last SIMs.<br/><br>|
|filter[iccid]|query|string|false|A search string to partially match for the SIM card's ICCID.|

> Example responses

```json
  "data": [

    }

    "page_size": 25,
    "total_pages": 3,
    "total_results": 55
  }
}
```

## Deletes a SIM card

<a id="opIdSimCardDelete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/sim_cards/6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /sim_cards/{id}`

The SIM card will be decommissioned, removed from your account and you will stop being charged.<br />The SIM card won't be able to connect to the network after the deletion is completed, thus making it impossible to consume data.<br/>
Transitioning to the disabled state may take a period of time.</br>
Until the transition is completed, the SIM card status will be disabling <code>disabling</code>.<br />In order to re-enable the SIM card, you will need to re-register it.

## Set network preferences

<a id="opIdSIMCardNetworkPreferencesPut"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/sim_cards/6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58/network_preferences \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "mobile_operator_networks_preferences": [
      {
        "mobile_operator_network_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
        "priority": 0
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /sim_cards/{sim_card_id}/network_preferences`

This API allows setting or updating a SIM card network preference. <br/><br/>
Every SIM card has default network preferences defined on Telnyx. These preferences will determine how a SIMCard will connect to the network by considering a list of preferable operators.<br/><br/>
There can be multiple scenarios where an operator can be preferred over another, for example, when a specific mobile operator can provide better network latency or better pricing.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "mobile_operator_networks_preferences": [
    {
      "mobile_operator_network_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
      "priority": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="set-network-preferences-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sim_card_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Identifies a SIM card.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» mobile_operator_networks_preferences|body|[[MobileOperatorNetworkPreferencesRequest](#schemamobileoperatornetworkpreferencesrequest)]|false|A list of mobile operator networks and the priority that should be applied when the SIM is connecting to the network.|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
    "mobile_operator_networks_preferences": [
      {
        "mobile_operator_network_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
        "mobile_operator_network_name": "AT&T Mobility (USACG)",
        "priority": 0
      }
    ],
    "ota_updates": [
      {
        "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
        "id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
        "record_type": "ota_update",
        "settings": {
          "mobile_operator_networks_preferences": [
            {
              "mobile_operator_network_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
              "mobile_operator_network_name": "AT&T Mobility (USACG)",
              "priority": 0
            }
          ]
        },
        "sim_card_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
        "status": "in-progress",
        "type": "sim_card_network_preferences",
        "updated_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z"
      }
    ],
    "record_type": "sim_card_network_preferences",
    "sim_card_id": "6b14e151-8493-4fa1-8664-1cc4e6d14158",
    "updated_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z"
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "detail": "string",
```

<h3 id="set-network-preferences-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|A successful network preferences definition response. <br/><br/><br>The sent mobile_operator_networks_preferences parameter won't be applied to the main resource right away - this is an asynchronous operation. While interacting with this API, you will face the following scenarios:<br><br>  * The first request for this API will return an empty mobile_operator_networks_preferences with an in-progress OTA update resource in the ota_updates node containing the exact sent parameters to indicate the operation progress. The value will be applied to the principal object when the OTA update finishes its processing, thus indicating the SIM card network preference current state. <br>  * The subsequent requests will contain the current state, that is what's applied to the SIM card settings, and return the related OTA update in the ota_updates node.<br>  <br>The returned OTA updated (present in the ota_updates node) will, by default, be the resource related to the operation, not all of them.|Inline|
|default|Default|Unexpected error|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|

## Set SIM card public IP

<a id="opIdSIMCardPublicIPPost"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/sim_cards/6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58/public_ip \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /sim_cards/{sim_card_id}/public_ip`

This API will asynchronously map a random public IP to a SIM card, making it reachable on the public internet. <br/><br/>
 The request will return the resource as "provisioning" right away, and it'll eventually get "provisioned", meaning it completed the setup. <br/><br/>
 Setting up a public IP will generate charges, and we won't be able to provide the IP if the account doesn't have a balance. In that case, this operation will succeed, but its status will change to failed eventually, and the resource will be updated with the associated status. The IP resource will need to be deleted and re-created with our DELETE and POST APIs in this scenario.

<h3 id="set-sim-card-public-ip-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sim_card_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Identifies a SIM card.|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "data": {
    "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",

    "record_type": "sim_card_public_ip",
    "sim_card_id": "6b14e151-8493-4fa1-8664-1cc4e6d14158",
    "status": {
      "error_code": null,
      "error_description": null,
      "value": "provisioned"
    },

  }
}
```

<a id="opIdCreateTexmlApplication"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/texml_applications \

    "active": false,

      "channel_limit": 10,
      "sip_subdomain": "example",
      "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
    },
    "outbound": {
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
    },
    "status_callback": "https://example.com",
    "status_callback_method": "get",
    "voice_fallback_url": "https://fallback.example.com",
    "voice_method": "get",
    "voice_url": "https://example.com"
  }'
```

`POST /texml_applications`

Creates a TeXML Application.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "active": false,
  "anchorsite_override": "Amsterdam, Netherlands",
  "dtmf_type": "Inband",
  "first_command_timeout": true,
  "first_command_timeout_secs": 10,
  "friendly_name": "call-router",
  "inbound": {
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "sip_subdomain": "example",
    "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
  },
  "outbound": {
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
  },
  "status_callback": "https://example.com",
  "status_callback_method": "get",
  "voice_fallback_url": "https://fallback.example.com",
  "voice_method": "get",
  "voice_url": "https://example.com"
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-texml-application-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateTexmlApplicationRequest](#schemacreatetexmlapplicationrequest)|true|Parameters that can be set when creating a TeXML Application|
|» active|body|[ConnectionActive](#schemaconnectionactive)|false|Specifies whether the connection can be used.|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» dtmf_type|body|[DtmfType](#schemadtmftype)|false|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|» first_command_timeout|body|[FirstCommandTimeout](#schemafirstcommandtimeout)|false|Specifies whether calls to phone numbers associated with this connection should hangup after timing out.|
|» first_command_timeout_secs|body|[FirstCommandTimeoutSecs](#schemafirstcommandtimeoutsecs)|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a dial command.|
|» friendly_name|body|[ApplicationName](#schemaapplicationname)|true|A user-assigned name to help manage the application.|
|» inbound|body|object|false|none|
|» » channel_limit|body|integer|false|When set, this will limit the total number of inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|» » sip_subdomain|body|string|false|Specifies a subdomain that can be used to receive Inbound calls to a Connection, in the same way a phone number is used, from a SIP endpoint. Example: the subdomain "example.sip.telnyx.com" can be called from any SIP endpoint by using the SIP URI "sip:@example.sip.telnyx.com" where the user part can be any alphanumeric value. Please note TLS encrypted calls are not allowed for subdomain calls.|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|body|string|false|This option can be enabled to receive calls from: "Anyone" (any SIP endpoint in the public Internet) or "Only my connections" (any connection assigned to the same Telnyx user).|
|» outbound|body|object|false|none|
|» » channel_limit|body|integer|false|When set, this will limit the total number of outbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|» » outbound_voice_profile_id|body|[OutboundVoiceProfileId](#schemaoutboundvoiceprofileid)|false|Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.|
|» status_callback|body|string(url)|false|URL for Telnyx to send requests to containing information about call progress events.|
|» status_callback_method|body|string|false|HTTP request method Telnyx should use when requesting the status_callback URL.|
|» voice_fallback_url|body|string(url)|false|URL to which Telnyx will deliver your XML Translator webhooks if we get an error response from your voice_url.|
|» voice_method|body|string|false|HTTP request method Telnyx will use to interact with your XML Translator webhooks. Either 'get' or 'post'.|
|» voice_url|body|string(url)|true|URL to which Telnyx will deliver your XML Translator webhooks.|

#### Enumerated Values

|» anchorsite_override|Latency|
|» anchorsite_override|Chicago, IL|
|» anchorsite_override|Ashburn, VA|

<h3 id="update-a-texml-application-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(int64)|true|Identifies the resource.|
|body|body|[UpdateTexmlApplicationRequest](#schemaupdatetexmlapplicationrequest)|true|Parameters that can be updated in a TeXML Application|
|» active|body|[ConnectionActive](#schemaconnectionactive)|false|Specifies whether the connection can be used.|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» dtmf_type|body|[DtmfType](#schemadtmftype)|false|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|» first_command_timeout|body|[FirstCommandTimeout](#schemafirstcommandtimeout)|false|Specifies whether calls to phone numbers associated with this connection should hangup after timing out.|
|» first_command_timeout_secs|body|[FirstCommandTimeoutSecs](#schemafirstcommandtimeoutsecs)|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a dial command.|
|» friendly_name|body|[ApplicationName](#schemaapplicationname)|true|A user-assigned name to help manage the application.|
|» inbound|body|object|false|none|
|» » channel_limit|body|integer|false|When set, this will limit the total number of inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|» » sip_subdomain|body|string|false|Specifies a subdomain that can be used to receive Inbound calls to a Connection, in the same way a phone number is used, from a SIP endpoint. Example: the subdomain "example.sip.telnyx.com" can be called from any SIP endpoint by using the SIP URI "sip:@example.sip.telnyx.com" where the user part can be any alphanumeric value. Please note TLS encrypted calls are not allowed for subdomain calls.|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|body|string|false|This option can be enabled to receive calls from: "Anyone" (any SIP endpoint in the public Internet) or "Only my connections" (any connection assigned to the same Telnyx user).|
|» outbound|body|object|false|none|
|» » channel_limit|body|integer|false|When set, this will limit the total number of outbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|» » outbound_voice_profile_id|body|[OutboundVoiceProfileId](#schemaoutboundvoiceprofileid)|false|Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.|
|» status_callback|body|string(url)|false|URL for Telnyx to send requests to containing information about call progress events.|
|» status_callback_method|body|string|false|HTTP request method Telnyx should use when requesting the status_callback URL.|
|» voice_fallback_url|body|string(url)|false|URL to which Telnyx will deliver your XML Translator webhooks if we get an error response from your voice_url.|
|» voice_method|body|string|false|HTTP request method Telnyx will use to interact with your XML Translator webhooks. Either 'get' or 'post'.|
|» voice_url|body|string(url)|true|URL to which Telnyx will deliver your XML Translator webhooks.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» anchorsite_override|Latency|
|» anchorsite_override|Chicago, IL|
|» anchorsite_override|Ashburn, VA|
|» anchorsite_override|San Jose, CA|
|» anchorsite_override|Sydney, Australia|
|» anchorsite_override|Amsterdam, Netherlands|

|» anchorsite_override|Toronto, Canada|

|» dtmf_type|Inband|

|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|only_my_connections|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|from_anyone|
|» status_callback_method|get|
|» status_callback_method|post|
|» voice_method|get|
|» voice_method|post|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-webhooks">Webhooks</h1>

Webhooks operations

## List webhook deliveries

<a id="opIdgetWebhookDeliveries"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/webhook_deliveries \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /webhook_deliveries`

Lists webhook_deliveries for the authenticated user

<h3 id="list-webhook-deliveries-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filter[status][eq]|query|string|false|Return only webhook_deliveries matching the given `status`|
|filter[webhook][contains]|query|string|false|Return only webhook deliveries whose `webhook` component contains the given text|
|filter[attempts][contains]|query|string|false|Return only webhook_deliveries whose `attempts` component contains the given text|
|filter[started_at][gte]|query|string|false|Return only webhook_deliveries whose delivery started later than or at given ISO 8601 datetime|
|filter[started_at][lte]|query|string|false|Return only webhook_deliveries whose delivery started earlier than or at given ISO 8601 datetime|
|filter[finished_at][gte]|query|string|false|Return only webhook_deliveries whose delivery finished later than or at given ISO 8601 datetime|
|filter[finished_at][lte]|query|string|false|Return only webhook_deliveries whose delivery finished earlier than or at given ISO 8601 datetime|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|The page number to load.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|The size of the page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|filter[status][eq]|delivered|
|filter[status][eq]|failed|

```json
        {

          "finished_at": "2020-08-10T14:00:05.360Z",
          "http": {
            "request": {
              "headers": [
                "Accept: */*"
              ],
```

## Check Contact

<a id="opIdcheckContact"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/whatsapp_contacts \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "blocking": "wait",
    "contacts": [
      "15125551000",
      "+1 512 555 1001",
      "5125551002",
      "+1 (512) 555-1004",
      "1-512-555-1005"
    ],
    "whatsapp_user_id": "15125551212"
  }'
```

`POST /whatsapp_contacts`

Verify that a phone number belongs to a valid WhatsApp account. You must ensure that the status is valid before you can message a user, and you'll get their WhatsApp ID to use for messaging.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "blocking": "wait",
  "contacts": [
    "15125551000",
    "+1 512 555 1001",
    "5125551002",
    "+1 (512) 555-1004",
    "1-512-555-1005"
  ],
  "whatsapp_user_id": "15125551212"
}
```

<h3 id="check-contact-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CheckContactRequestBody](#schemacheckcontactrequestbody)|true|none|
|» blocking|body|string|false|Blocking determines whether the request should wait for the processing to complete (synchronous) or not (asynchronous).|
|» contacts|body|[string]|true|Array of contact phone numbers. The numbers can be in any standard telephone number format.|
|» whatsapp_user_id|body|string|true|The sender's WhatsApp ID.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» blocking|no_wait|
|» blocking|wait|

> Example responses

```json
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "15125551234",

      "status": "valid"
    }
  ]
}
```

`POST /reports/batch_mdr_reports`

Submit a request for new messaging detail report. Messaging detail report pulls all raw messaging data according to defined filters.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "connections": [
    0
  ],
  "directions": [
    "INBOUND"
  ],
  "end_date": "2020-07-01T00:00:00-06:00",
  "filters": [
    {
      "billing_group": "adfaa016-f921-4b6c-97bb-e4c1dad231c5",
      "cld": "+13129457420",
      "cld_filter": "contains",
      "cli": "+13129457420",
      "cli_filter": "contains",
      "filter_type": "and",
      "tags_list": "tag1"
    }
  ],
  "include_message_body": true,
  "profiles": "My profile",
  "record_types": [
    "INCOMPLETE"
  ],
  "report_name": "string",
  "start_date": "2020-07-01T00:00:00-06:00"
}
```

<h3 id="submitmdrrequest-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[MdrPostDetailReportRequest](#schemamdrpostdetailreportrequest)|true|Mdr detail request data|
|» connections|body|[integer(int64)]|false|none|
|» directions|body|[string]|false|none|
|» end_date|body|string(date-time)|true|none|
|» filters|body|[[Filter](#schemafilter)]|false|none|
|» include_message_body|body|boolean|false|none|
|» profiles|body|string|false|none|
|» record_types|body|[string]|false|none|
|» report_name|body|string|false|none|
|» start_date|body|string(date-time)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|string|true|none|The Call Control ID of the call you want to bridge with.|
|client_state|string|false|none|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|command_id|string|false|none|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore commands with the same `command_id`.|
|park_after_unbridge|string|false|none|Specifies behavior after the bridge ends (i.e. the opposite leg either hangs up or is transferred). If supplied with the value `self`, the current leg will be parked after unbridge. If not set, the default behavior is to hang up the leg.|
|queue|string|false|none|The name of the queue you want to bridge with, can't be used together with call_control_id parameter. Bridging with a queue means bridging with the first call in the queue. The call will always be removed from the queue regardless of whether bridging succeeds. Returns an error when the queue is empty.|

```json
  },
```

```json
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",

  "custom_headers": [
    {

    },

      "value": "val_2"
    }
  ],
  "from": "+18005550101",
  "from_display_name": "Company Name",
  "link_to": "ilditnZK_eVysupV21KzmzN_sM29ygfauQojpm4BgFtfX5hXAcjotg==",
  "sip_auth_password": "password",
  "sip_auth_username": "username",
  "timeout_limit_secs": 60,
  "timeout_secs": 60,
  "to": "+18005550100 or sip:username@sip.telnyx.com",
  "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/server-b/",
  "webhook_url_method": "POST"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|answering_machine_detection|string|false|none|Enables Answering Machine Detection. When a call is answered, Telnyx runs real-time detection to determine if it was picked up by a human or a machine and sends an `call.machine.detection.ended` webhook with the analysis result. If 'greeting_end' or 'detect_words' is used and a 'machine' is detected, you will receive another 'call.machine.greeting.ended' webhook when the answering machine greeting ends with a beep or silence. If `detect_beep` is used, you will only receive 'call.machine.greeting.ended' if a beep is detected.|
|answering_machine_detection_config|object|false|none|Optional configuration parameters to modify 'answering_machine_detection' performance.|
|audio_url|string|false|none|The URL of a file to be played back to the callee when the call is answered. The URL can point to either a WAV or MP3 file. media_name and audio_url cannot be used together in one request.|
|billing_group_id|string(uuid)|false|none|Use this field to set the Billing Group ID for the call. Must be a valid and existing Billing Group ID.|
|client_state|string|false|none|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|command_id|string|false|none|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore commands with the same `command_id`.|
|connection_id|string|true|none|The ID of the Call Control App (formerly ID of the connection) to be used when dialing the destination.|
|custom_headers|[[CustomSipHeader](#schemacustomsipheader)]|false|none|Custom headers to be added to the SIP INVITE.|
|from|string|true|none|The `from` number to be used as the caller id presented to the destination (`to` number). The number should be in +E164 format. This attribute will default to the `from` number of the original call if omitted.|
|from_display_name|string|false|none|The `from_display_name` string to be used as the caller id name (SIP From Display Name) presented to the destination (`to` number). The string should have a maximum of 128 characters, containing only letters, numbers, spaces, and -_~!.+ special characters. If ommited, the display name will be the same as the number in the `from` field.|
|link_to|string|false|none|Use another call's control id for sharing the same call session id|
|media_name|string|false|none|The media_name of a file to be played back to the callee when the call is answered. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file.|
|sip_auth_password|string|false|none|SIP Authentication password used for SIP challenges.|
|sip_auth_username|string|false|none|SIP Authentication username used for SIP challenges.|
|time_limit_secs|integer(int32)|false|none|Sets the maximum duration of a Call Control Leg in seconds. If the time limit is reached, the call will hangup and a `call.hangup` webhook with a `hangup_cause` of `time_limit` will be sent. For example, by setting a time limit of 120 seconds, a Call Leg will be automatically terminated two minutes after being answered. The default time limit is 14400 seconds or 4 hours and this is also the maximum allowed call length.|
|timeout_secs|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of seconds that Telnyx will wait for the call to be answered by the destination to which it is being called. If the timeout is reached before an answer is received, the call will hangup and a `call.hangup` webhook with a `hangup_cause` of `timeout` will be sent. Minimum value is 5 seconds. Maximum value is 120 seconds.|
|to|string|true|none|The DID or SIP URI to dial out to.|
|webhook_url|string|false|none|Use this field to override the URL for which Telnyx will send subsequent webhooks to for this call.|
|webhook_url_method|string|false|none|HTTP request type used for `webhook_url`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|answering_machine_detection|detect|
|answering_machine_detection|detect_beep|
|answering_machine_detection|detect_words|
|answering_machine_detection|greeting_end|
|answering_machine_detection|disabled|
|webhook_url_method|POST|
|webhook_url_method|GET|

```json
{
  "call_control_id": "v2:T02llQxIyaRkhfRKxgAP8nY511EhFLizdvdUKJiSw8d6A9BborherQ",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "from": "+18005550101",
  "hold": true,
  "hold_audio_url": "http://www.example.com/audio.wav",
  "mute": true,
  "start_conference_on_enter": true,
  "supervisor_role": "whisper",
  "to": "+18005550100",
  "whisper_call_control_ids": [
    "v2:Sg1xxxQ_U3ixxxyXT_VDNI3xxxazZdg6Vxxxs4-GNYxxxVaJPOhFMRQ",
    "v2:qqpb0mmvd-ovhhBr0BUQQn0fld5jIboaaX3-De0DkqXHzbf8d75xkw"
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|string|true|none|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|client_state|string|false|none|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|command_id|string|false|none|Use this field to avoid execution of duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore subsequent commands with the same `command_id` as one that has already been executed.|
|from|string|true|none|The `from` number to be used as the caller id presented to the destination (`to` number).|
|hold|boolean|false|none|Whether the participant should be put on hold immediately after joining the conference.|
|hold_audio_url|string|false|none|The URL of a file to be played to the participant when they are put on hold after joining the conference. If media_name is also supplied, this is currently ignored. Takes effect only when "start_conference_on_create" is set to "false". This property takes effect only if "hold" is set to "true".|
|hold_media_name|string|false|none|The media_name of a file to be played to the participant when they are put on hold after joining the conference. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file. Takes effect only when "start_conference_on_create" is set to "false". This property takes effect only if "hold" is set to "true".|
|mute|boolean|false|none|Whether the participant should be muted immediately after joining the conference.|
|start_conference_on_enter|boolean|false|none|Whether the conference should be started after the participant joins the conference.|
|supervisor_role|string|false|none|Sets the joining participant as a supervisor for the conference. A conference can have multiple supervisors. "barge" means the supervisor enters the conference as a normal participant. This is the same as "none". "monitor" means the supervisor is muted but can hear all participants. "whisper" means that only the specified "whisper_call_control_ids" can hear the supervisor. Defaults to "none".|
|to|string|true|none|The DID or SIP URI to dial out and bridge to the given call.|
|whisper_call_control_ids|[string]|false|none|Array of unique call_control_ids the joining supervisor can whisper to. If none provided, the supervisor will join the conference as a monitoring participant only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|supervisor_role|barge|
|supervisor_role|monitor|
|supervisor_role|none|
|supervisor_role|whisper|

<h2 id="tocS_ConferencePlayRequest">ConferencePlayRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaconferenceplayrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_ConferencePlayRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSconferenceplayrequest"></a>
<a id="tocsconferenceplayrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "audio_url": "http://www.example.com/sounds/greeting.wav"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|audio_url|string|false|none|The URL of a file to be played back in the conference. media_name and audio_url cannot be used together in one request.|
|call_control_ids|[string]|false|none|List of call control ids identifying participants the audio file should be played to. If not given, the audio file will be played to the entire conference.|
|loop|[Loopcount](#schemaloopcount)|false|none|The number of times the audio file should be played. If supplied, the value must be an integer between 1 and 100, or the special string `infinity` for an endless loop.|
|media_name|string|false|none|The media_name of a file to be played back in the conference. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file.|

|channel_limit|integer|false|none|When set, this will limit the total number of inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|codecs|[string]|false|none|Defines the list of codecs that Telnyx will send for inbound calls to a specific number on your portal account, in priority order. This only works when the Connection the number is assigned to uses Media Handling mode: default. OPUS and H.264 codecs are available only when using TCP or TLS transport for SIP.|
|default_routing_method|string|false|none|Default routing method to be used when a number is associated with the connection. Must be one of the routing method types or left blank, other values are not allowed.|
|dnis_number_format|string|false|none|none|
|generate_ringback_tone|boolean|false|none|Generate ringback tone through 183 session progress message with early media.|
|isup_headers_enabled|boolean|false|none|When set, inbound phone calls will receive ISUP parameters via SIP headers. (Only when available and only when using TCP or TLS transport.)|
|prack_enabled|boolean|false|none|Enable PRACK messages as defined in RFC3262.|
|privacy_zone_enabled|boolean|false|none|By default, Telnyx does not send caller-id information when the caller has chosen to hide this information. When this option is enabled, Telnyx will send the SIP header Privacy:id plus the caller-id information so that the receiver side can choose when to hide it.|
|sip_compact_headers_enabled|boolean|false|none|Defaults to true.|
|sip_region|string|false|none|Selects which `sip_region` to receive inbound calls from. If null, the default region (US) will be used.|
|sip_subdomain|string|false|none|Specifies a subdomain that can be used to receive Inbound calls to a Connection, in the same way a phone number is used, from a SIP endpoint. Example: the subdomain "example.sip.telnyx.com" can be called from any SIP endpoint by using the SIP URI "sip:@example.sip.telnyx.com" where the user part can be any alphanumeric value. Please note TLS encrypted calls are not allowed for subdomain calls.|
|sip_subdomain_receive_settings|string|false|none|This option can be enabled to receive calls from: "Anyone" (any SIP endpoint in the public Internet) or "Only my connections" (any connection assigned to the same Telnyx user).|
|timeout_1xx_secs|integer|false|none|Time(sec) before aborting if connection is not made.|
|timeout_2xx_secs|integer|false|none|Time(sec) before aborting if call is unanswered (min: 1, max: 600).|

The use of custom links can improve branding and message<br>deliverability.<br><br>To disable this feature, set the object field to `null`.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ani_number_format|string|false|none|This setting allows you to set the format with which the caller's number (ANI) is sent for inbound phone calls.|
|channel_limit|integer|false|none|When set, this will limit the total number of inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|codecs|[string]|false|none|Defines the list of codecs that Telnyx will send for inbound calls to a specific number on your portal account, in priority order. This only works when the Connection the number is assigned to uses Media Handling mode: default. OPUS and H.264 codecs are available only when using TCP or TLS transport for SIP.|
|dnis_number_format|string|false|none|none|
|generate_ringback_tone|boolean|false|none|Generate ringback tone through 183 session progress message with early media.|
|isup_headers_enabled|boolean|false|none|When set, inbound phone calls will receive ISUP parameters via SIP headers. (Only when available and only when using TCP or TLS transport.)|
|prack_enabled|boolean|false|none|Enable PRACK messages as defined in RFC3262.|
|privacy_zone_enabled|boolean|false|none|By default, Telnyx does not send caller-id information when the caller has chosen to hide this information. When this option is enabled, Telnyx will send the SIP header Privacy:id plus the caller-id information so that the receiver side can choose when to hide it.|
|sip_compact_headers_enabled|boolean|false|none|Defaults to true.|
|timeout_1xx_secs|integer|false|none|Time(sec) before aborting if connection is not made.|
|timeout_2xx_secs|string|false|none|Time(sec) before aborting if call is unanswered (min: 1, max: 600).|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ani_override|string|false|none|Set a phone number as the ani_override value to override caller id number on outbound calls.|
|ani_override_type|string|false|none|Specifies when we apply your ani_override setting. Only applies when ani_override is not blank.|
|call_parking_enabled|boolean|false|none|Forces all SIP calls originated on this connection to be "parked" instead of "bridged" to the destination specified on the URI. Parked calls will return ringback to the caller and will await for a Call Control command to define which action will be taken next.|
|channel_limit|integer|false|none|When set, this will limit the total number of outbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|generate_ringback_tone|boolean|false|none|Generate ringback tone through 183 session progress message with early media.|
|instant_ringback_enabled|boolean|false|none|When set, ringback will not wait for indication before sending ringback tone to calling party.|
|localization|string|false|none|A 2-character country code specifying the country whose national dialing rules should be used. For example, if set to `US` then any US number can be dialed without preprending +1 to the number. When left blank, Telnyx will try US and GB dialing rules, in that order, by default.|
|outbound_voice_profile_id|[OutboundVoiceProfileId](#schemaoutboundvoiceprofileid)|false|none|Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.|
|t38_reinvite_source|string|false|none|This setting only affects connections with Fax-type Outbound Voice Profiles. The setting dictates whether or not Telnyx sends a t.38 reinvite.<br/><br/> By default, Telnyx will send the re-invite. If set to `customer`, the caller is expected to send the t.38 reinvite.|

Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|connection_name|string|true|none|none|
|created_at|string|false|none|ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.|
|default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled|boolean|false|none|When enabled, Telnyx will generate comfort noise when you place the call on hold. If disabled, you will need to generate comfort noise or on hold music to avoid RTP timeout.|
|dtmf_type|[DtmfType](#schemadtmftype)|false|none|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|encode_contact_header_enabled|boolean|false|none|Encode the SIP contact header sent by Telnyx to avoid issues for NAT or ALG scenarios.|
|encrypted_media|[EncryptedMedia](#schemaencryptedmedia)|false|none|Enable use of SRTP or ZRTP for encryption. Valid values are those listed or null. Cannot be set to non-null if the transport_portocol is TLS.|
|id|string(int64)|false|none|Identifies the resource.|
|inbound|[InboundFqdn](#schemainboundfqdn)|false|none|none|
|onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled|boolean|false|none|Enable on-net T38 if you prefer that the sender and receiver negotiate T38 directly when both are on the Telnyx network. If this is disabled, Telnyx will be able to use T38 on just one leg of the call according to each leg's settings.|
|record_type|string|false|none|Identifies the type of the resource.|
|rtcp_settings|[ConnectionRtcpSettings](#schemaconnectionrtcpsettings)|false|none|none|
|transport_protocol|[FqdnConnectionTransportProtocol](#schemafqdnconnectiontransportprotocol)|false|none|One of UDP, TLS, or TCP. Applies only to connections with IP authentication or FQDN authentication.|
|updated_at|string|false|none|ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.|
|webhook_api_version|string|false|none|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1 or v2.|
|webhook_event_failover_url|string(url) \| null|false|none|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|webhook_event_url|string(url)|false|none|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|

```json
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",

  "invalid_audio_url": "http://example.com/message.wav",

  "valid_digits": "123"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|audio_url|string|false|none|The URL of a file to be played back at the beginning of each prompt. The URL can point to either a WAV or MP3 file. media_name and audio_url cannot be used together in one request.|
|client_state|string|false|none|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|command_id|string|false|none|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore commands with the same `command_id`.|
|inter_digit_timeout_millis|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of milliseconds to wait for input between digits.|
|invalid_audio_url|string|false|none|The URL of a file to play when digits don't match the `valid_digits` parameter or the number of digits is not between `min` and `max`. The URL can point to either a WAV or MP3 file. invalid_media_name and invalid_audio_url cannot be used together in one request.|
|invalid_media_name|string|false|none|The media_name of a file to be played back when digits don't match the `valid_digits` parameter or the number of digits is not between `min` and `max`. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file.|
|maximum_digits|integer(int32)|false|none|The maximum number of digits to fetch. This parameter has a maximum value of 128.|
|maximum_tries|integer(int32)|false|none|The maximum number of times the file should be played if there is no input from the user on the call.|
|media_name|string|false|none|The media_name of a file to be played back at the beginning of each prompt. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file.|
|minimum_digits|integer(int32)|false|none|The minimum number of digits to fetch. This parameter has a minimum value of 1.|
|terminating_digit|string|false|none|The digit used to terminate input if fewer than `maximum_digits` digits have been gathered.|
|timeout_millis|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of milliseconds to wait for a DTMF response after file playback ends before a replaying the sound file.|
|valid_digits|string|false|none|A list of all digits accepted as valid.|

|timeout_millis|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of milliseconds to wait for a DTMF response after speak ends before a replaying the sound file.|
|valid_digits|string|false|none|A list of all digits accepted as valid.|

<!-- backwards compatibility -->

<a id="tocsjoinconferencerequest"></a>

```json
{
  "beep_enabled": "always",
  "call_control_id": "v2:T02llQxIyaRkhfRKxgAP8nY511EhFLizdvdUKJiSw8d6A9BborherQ",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "end_conference_on_exit": true,
  "hold": true,
  "hold_audio_url": "http://www.example.com/audio.wav",
  "mute": true,
  "start_conference_on_enter": true,
  "supervisor_role": "whisper",
  "whisper_call_control_ids": [
    "v2:Sg1xxxQ_U3ixxxyXT_VDNI3xxxazZdg6Vxxxs4-GNYxxxVaJPOhFMRQ",
    "v2:qqpb0mmvd-ovhhBr0BUQQn0fld5jIboaaX3-De0DkqXHzbf8d75xkw"
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|beep_enabled|string|false|none|Whether a beep sound should be played when the participant joins and/or leaves the conference. Can be used to override the conference-level setting.|
|call_control_id|string|true|none|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|client_state|string|false|none|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|command_id|string|false|none|Use this field to avoid execution of duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore subsequent commands with the same `command_id` as one that has already been executed.|
|end_conference_on_exit|boolean|false|none|Whether the conference should end and all remaining participants be hung up after the participant leaves the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|hold|boolean|false|none|Whether the participant should be put on hold immediately after joining the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|hold_audio_url|string|false|none|The URL of a file to be played to the participant when they are put on hold after joining the conference. hold_media_name and hold_audio_url cannot be used together in one request. Takes effect only when "start_conference_on_create" is set to "false". This property takes effect only if "hold" is set to "true".|
|hold_media_name|string|false|none|The media_name of a file to be played to the participant when they are put on hold after joining the conference. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file. Takes effect only when "start_conference_on_create" is set to "false". This property takes effect only if "hold" is set to "true".|
|mute|boolean|false|none|Whether the participant should be muted immediately after joining the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|soft_end_conference_on_exit|boolean|false|none|Whether the conference should end after the participant leaves the conference. NOTE this doesn't hang up the other participants. Defaults to "false".|
|start_conference_on_enter|boolean|false|none|Whether the conference should be started after the participant joins the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|supervisor_role|string|false|none|Sets the joining participant as a supervisor for the conference. A conference can have multiple supervisors. "barge" means the supervisor enters the conference as a normal participant. This is the same as "none". "monitor" means the supervisor is muted but can hear all participants. "whisper" means that only the specified "whisper_call_control_ids" can hear the supervisor. Defaults to "none".|
|whisper_call_control_ids|[string]|false|none|Array of unique call_control_ids the joining supervisor can whisper to. If none provided, the supervisor will join the conference as a monitoring participant only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|beep_enabled|always|
|beep_enabled|never|
|beep_enabled|on_enter|
|beep_enabled|on_exit|
|supervisor_role|barge|
|supervisor_role|monitor|
|supervisor_role|none|
|supervisor_role|whisper|

The media features settings for a phone number.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accept_any_rtp_packets_enabled|boolean|false|none|When enabled, Telnyx will accept RTP packets from any customer-side IP address and port, not just those to which Telnyx is sending RTP.|
|media_handling_mode|string|false|none|Controls how media is handled for the phone number. default: media routed through Telnyx with transcode support. proxy: media routed through Telnyx with no transcode support.|
|rtp_auto_adjust_enabled|boolean|false|none|When RTP Auto-Adjust is enabled, the destination RTP address port will be automatically changed to match the source of the incoming RTP packets.|
|t38_fax_gateway_enabled|boolean|false|none|Controls whether Telnyx will accept a T.38 re-INVITE for this phone number. Note that Telnyx will not send a T.38 re-INVITE; this option only controls whether one will be accepted.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|cld|string|false|none|The recipient of the message (to parameter in the Messaging API)|
|cli|string|false|none|The sender of the message (from parameter in the Messaging API). For Alphanumeric ID messages, this is the sender ID value|
|completed_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Message completion time|
|cost|string|false|none|Amount, in the user currency, for the Telnyx billing cost|
|country_code|string|false|none|Two-letter representation of the country of the cld property using the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Message creation time|
|currency|string|false|none|Telnyx account currency used to describe monetary values, including billing cost|
|delivery_status|string|false|none|Final webhook delivery status|
|delivery_status_failover_url|string|false|none|Failover customer-provided URL which Telnyx posts delivery status webhooks to|
|delivery_status_webhook_url|string|false|none|Primary customer-provided URL which Telnyx posts delivery status webhooks to|
|direction|string|false|none|Logical direction of the message from the Telnyx customer's perspective. It's inbound when the Telnyx customer receives the message, or outbound otherwise|
|errors|[string]|false|none|Telnyx API error codes returned by the Telnyx gateway|
|fteu|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether this is a Free-To-End-User (FTEU) short code message|
|mcc|string|false|none|Mobile country code. Only available for certain products, such as Global Outbound-Only from Alphanumeric Sender ID|
|message_type|string|false|none|Describes the Messaging service used to send the message. Available services are: Short Message Service (SMS), Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS), and Rich Communication Services (RCS)|
|mnc|string|false|none|Mobile network code. Only available for certain products, such as Global Outbound-Only from Alphanumeric Sender ID|
|on_net|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether both sender and recipient numbers are Telnyx-managed|
|parts|integer|false|none|Number of message parts. The message is broken down in multiple parts when its length surpasses the limit of 160 characters|
|profile_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the Messaging Profile used to send or receive the message|
|profile_name|string|false|none|Name of the Messaging Profile used to send or receive the message|
|rate|string|false|none|Currency amount per billing unit used to calculate the Telnyx billing cost|
|record_type|string|true|none|Identifies the record schema|
|sent_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Time when the message was sent|
|source_country_code|string|false|none|Two-letter representation of the country of the cli property using the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format|
|status|string|false|none|Final status of the message after the delivery attempt|
|tags|string|false|none|Comma-separated tags assigned to the Telnyx number associated with the message|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Message updated time|
|user_id|string|false|none|Identifier of the Telnyx account who owns the message|
|uuid|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the message|

<h2 id="tocS_NumberPoolSettings">NumberPoolSettings</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemanumberpoolsettings"></a>
<a id="schema_NumberPoolSettings"></a>
<a id="tocSnumberpoolsettings"></a>
<a id="tocsnumberpoolsettings"></a>

```json
{
  "geomatch": false,
  "long_code_weight": 1,
  "skip_unhealthy": true,
  "sticky_sender": false,
  "toll_free_weight": 10
}
```

Number Pool allows you to send messages from a pool of numbers of different types, assigning
weights to each type. The pool consists of all the long code and toll free numbers
assigned to the messaging profile.

To disable this feature, set the object field to `null`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|geomatch|boolean|false|none|If set to true, Number Pool will try to choose a sending number with the same area code as the destination<br>number. If there are no such numbers available, a nunber with a different area code will be chosen. Currently<br>only NANP numbers are supported.<br>|
|long_code_weight|number|true|none|Defines the probability weight for a Long Code number to be selected when sending a message.<br>The higher the weight the higher the probability. The sum of the weights for all number types<br>does not necessarily need to add to 100.  Weight must be a non-negative number, and when equal<br>to zero it will remove the number type from the pool.<br>|
|skip_unhealthy|boolean|true|none|If set to true all unhealthy numbers will be automatically excluded from the pool.<br>Health metrics per number are calculated on a regular basis, taking into account the deliverability<br>rate and the amount of messages marked as spam by upstream carriers.<br>Numbers with a deliverability rate below 25% or spam ratio over 75% will be considered unhealthy.<br>|
|sticky_sender|boolean|false|none|If set to true, Number Pool will try to choose the same sending number for all messages to a particular<br>recipient. If the sending number becomes unhealthy and `skip_unhealthy` is set to true, a new<br>number will be chosen.<br>|
|toll_free_weight|number|true|none|Defines the probability weight for a Toll Free number to be selected when sending a message.<br>The higher the weight the higher the probability. The sum of the weights for all number types<br>does not necessarily need to add to 100. Weight must be a non-negative number, and when equal<br>to zero it will remove the number type from the pool.<br>|

|ani_override_type|string|false|none|Specifies when we apply your ani_override setting. Only applies when ani_override is not blank.|
|call_parking_enabled|boolean|false|none|Forces all SIP calls originated on this connection to be "parked" instead of "bridged" to the destination specified on the URI. Parked calls will return ringback to the caller and will await for a Call Control command to define which action will be taken next.|
|channel_limit|integer|false|none|When set, this will limit the total number of outbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|generate_ringback_tone|boolean|false|none|Generate ringback tone through 183 session progress message with early media.|
|instant_ringback_enabled|boolean|false|none|When set, ringback will not wait for indication before sending ringback tone to calling party.|
|ip_authentication_method|string|false|none|none|
|ip_authentication_token|string|false|none|none|
|localization|string|false|none|A 2-character country code specifying the country whose national dialing rules should be used. For example, if set to `US` then any US number can be dialed without preprending +1 to the number. When left blank, Telnyx will try US and GB dialing rules, in that order, by default.|
|outbound_voice_profile_id|[OutboundVoiceProfileId](#schemaoutboundvoiceprofileid)|false|none|Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.|
|t38_reinvite_source|string|false|none|This setting only affects connections with Fax-type Outbound Voice Profiles. The setting dictates whether or not Telnyx sends a t.38 reinvite.<br/><br/> By default, Telnyx will send the re-invite. If set to `customer`, the caller is expected to send the t.38 reinvite.|
|tech_prefix|string|false|none|Numerical chars only, exactly 4 characters.|

<h2 id="tocS_PlayAudioUrlRequest">PlayAudioUrlRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaplayaudiourlrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_PlayAudioUrlRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSplayaudiourlrequest"></a>
<a id="tocsplayaudiourlrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "audio_url": "http://www.example.com/sounds/greeting.wav",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "loop": "infinity",
  "overlay": true,
  "stop": "current",
  "target_legs": "self"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|audio_url|string|false|none|The URL of a file to be played back on the call. The URL can point to either a WAV or MP3 file. media_name and audio_url cannot be used together in one request.|
|client_state|string|false|none|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|command_id|string|false|none|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore commands with the same `command_id`.|
|loop|[Loopcount](#schemaloopcount)|false|none|The number of times the audio file should be played. If supplied, the value must be an integer between 1 and 100, or the special string `infinity` for an endless loop.|
|media_name|string|false|none|The media_name of a file to be played back on the call. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file.|
|overlay|boolean|false|none|When enabled, audio will be mixed on top of any other audio that is actively being played back. Note that `overlay: true` will only work if there is another audio file already being played on the call.|
|stop|string|false|none|When specified, it stops the current audio being played.  Specify `current` to stop the current audio being played, and to play the next file in the queue. Specify `all` to stop the current audio file being played and to also clear all audio files from the queue.|
|target_legs|string|false|none|Specifies the leg or legs on which audio will be played. If supplied, the value must be either `self`, `opposite` or `both`.|

<a id="schemasimcard"></a>
<a id="schema_SIMCard"></a>
<a id="tocSsimcard"></a>
<a id="tocssimcard"></a>

```json
{
  "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
  "iccid": "89310410106543789301",
  "id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
  "imsi": 81932214823362980,
  "ipv4": "192.168.0.0",
  "ipv6": "2001:cdba:0000:0000:0000:0000:3257:9652",
  "msisdn": "+13109976224",
  "record_type": "sim_card",
  "sim_card_group_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
  "status": "enabled",
  "tags": [
    "personal",
    "customers",
    "active-customers"
  ],
  "updated_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created_at|string|false|read-only|ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.|
|iccid|string|false|read-only|The ICCID is the identifier of the specific SIM card/chip. Each SIM is internationally identified by its integrated circuit card identifier (ICCID). ICCIDs are stored in the SIM card's memory and are also engraved or printed on the SIM card body during a process called personalization.<br>|
|id|string(uuid)|false|read-only|Identifies the resource.|
|imsi|string|false|read-only|SIM cards are identified on their individual operator networks by a unique International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI). <br/><br>Mobile network operators connect mobile phone calls and communicate with their market SIM cards using their IMSIs. The IMSI is stored in the Subscriber  Identity Module (SIM) inside the device and is sent by the device to the appropriate network. It is used to acquire the details of the device in the Home  Location Register (HLR) or the Visitor Location Register (VLR).<br>|
|ipv4|string|false|read-only|The SIM's address in the currently connected network. This IPv4 address is usually obtained dynamically, so it may vary according to the location or new connections.<br>|
|ipv6|string|false|read-only|The SIM's address in the currently connected network. This IPv6 address is usually obtained dynamically, so it may vary according to the location or new connections.<br>|
|msisdn|string|false|read-only|Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN) is a number used to identify a mobile phone number internationally. <br/><br>MSISDN is defined by the E.164 numbering plan. It includes a country code and a National Destination Code which identifies the subscriber's operator.<br>|
|record_type|string|false|read-only|none|
|sim_card_group_id|string(uuid)|false|none|The group SIMCardGroup identification. This attribute can be <code>null</code> when it's present in an associated resource.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The current status of the SIM card. It will be one of the following: <br/><br><ul><br> <li><code>registering</code> - the card is being registered</li><br> <li><code>enabling</code> - the card is being enabled</li><br> <li><code>enabled</code> - the card is enabled and ready for use</li><br> <li><code>disabling</code> - the card is being disabled</li><br> <li><code>disabled</code> - the card has been disabled and cannot be used</li><br> <li><code>data_limit_exceeded</code> - the card has exceeded its data consumption limit</li><br></ul><br>Transitioning between the enabled and disabled states may take a period of time.<br>|
|tags|[string]|false|none|Searchable tags associated with the SIM card|
|updated_at|string|false|read-only|ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|registering|
|status|enabling|
|status|enabled|
|status|disabling|
|status|disabled|
|status|data_limit_exceeded|

|sim_card_group_id|string(uuid)|false|none|The SIM card group identification.|

### Properties

|error_code|string|false|read-only|This attribute is an <a href="https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/api/v2/overview#errors">error code</a> related to the failure reason.|
|error_description|string|false|read-only|This attribute provides a human-readable explanation of why a failure happened.|
|value|string|false|read-only|The current status or failure details of the SIM card's public IP. <ul><br> <li><code>provisioning</code> - the IP is being provisioned.</li><br> <li><code>provisioned</code> - the IP was provisioned and the SIM is reachable on the public internet.</li><br> <li><code>failed</code> - the provisioning had failed for a reason and it requires an intervention.</li><br> <li><code>decommissioning</code> - the public IP is being removed from the SIM card.</li><br> </ul><br> Transitioning between the provisioning and provisioned states may take some time.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|value|provisioned|
|value|failed|
|value|decommissioning|

```json
    "total_analysis_time_millis": 5000
  },

  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",

  "custom_headers": [
    {
      "name": "head_1",
      "value": "val_1"
    },
    {
      "name": "head_2",
      "value": "val_2"
    }
  ],
  "from": "+18005550101",
  "from_display_name": "Company Name",
  "sip_auth_password": "password",
  "sip_auth_username": "username",
  "timeout_limit_secs": 60,
  "timeout_secs": 60,
  "to": "+18005550100 or sip:username@sip.telnyx.com",
  "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/server-b/",
  "webhook_url_method": "POST"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|answering_machine_detection|string|false|none|Enables Answering Machine Detection. When a call is answered, Telnyx runs real-time detection to determine if it was picked up by a human or a machine and sends an `call.machine.detection.ended` webhook with the analysis result. If 'greeting_end' or 'detect_words' is used and a 'machine' is detected, you will receive another 'call.machine.greeting.ended' webhook when the answering machine greeting ends with a beep or silence. If `detect_beep` is used, you will only receive 'call.machine.greeting.ended' if a beep is detected.|
|answering_machine_detection_config|object|false|none|Optional configuration parameters to modify 'answering_machine_detection' performance.|
|audio_url|string|false|none|The URL of a file to be played back when the transfer destination answers before bridging the call. The URL can point to either a WAV or MP3 file. media_name and audio_url cannot be used together in one request.|
|client_state|string|false|none|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|command_id|string|false|none|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore commands with the same `command_id`.|
|custom_headers|[[CustomSipHeader](#schemacustomsipheader)]|false|none|Custom headers to be added to the SIP INVITE.|
|from|string|false|none|The `from` number to be used as the caller id presented to the destination (`to` number). The number should be in +E164 format. This attribute will default to the `from` number of the original call if omitted.|
|from_display_name|string|false|none|The `from_display_name` string to be used as the caller id name (SIP From Display Name) presented to the destination (`to` number). The string should have a maximum of 128 characters, containing only letters, numbers, spaces, and -_~!.+ special characters. If ommited, the display name will be the same as the number in the `from` field.|
|media_name|string|false|none|The media_name of a file to be played back when the transfer destination answers before bridging the call. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file.|
|sip_auth_password|string|false|none|SIP Authentication password used for SIP challenges.|
|sip_auth_username|string|false|none|SIP Authentication username used for SIP challenges.|
|target_leg_client_state|string|false|none|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook for the new leg. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|time_limit_secs|integer(int32)|false|none|Sets the maximum duration of a Call Control Leg in seconds. If the time limit is reached, the call will hangup and a `call.hangup` webhook with a `hangup_cause` of `time_limit` will be sent. For example, by setting a time limit of 120 seconds, a Call Leg will be automatically terminated two minutes after being answered. The default time limit is 14400 seconds or 4 hours and this is also the maximum allowed call length.|
|timeout_secs|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of seconds that Telnyx will wait for the call to be answered by the destination to which it is being transferred. If the timeout is reached before an answer is received, the call will hangup and a `call.hangup` webhook with a `hangup_cause` of `timeout` will be sent. Minimum value is 5 seconds. Maximum value is 120 seconds.|
|to|string|true|none|The DID or SIP URI to dial out and bridge to the given call.|
|webhook_url|string|false|none|Use this field to override the URL for which Telnyx will send subsequent webhooks to for this call.|
|webhook_url_method|string|false|none|HTTP request type used for `webhook_url`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|answering_machine_detection|detect|
|answering_machine_detection|detect_beep|
|answering_machine_detection|detect_words|
|answering_machine_detection|greeting_end|
|answering_machine_detection|disabled|
|webhook_url_method|POST|
|webhook_url_method|GET|

<h2 id="tocS_UrlShortenerSettings">UrlShortenerSettings</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaurlshortenersettings"></a>
<a id="schema_UrlShortenerSettings"></a>
<a id="tocSurlshortenersettings"></a>
<a id="tocsurlshortenersettings"></a>

```json
{
  "domain": "example.ex",
  "prefix": "",
  "replace_blacklist_only": true,
  "send_webhooks": false
}
```

The URL shortener feature allows automatic replacement of URLs that were generated using
a public URL shortener service. Some examples include bit.do, bit.ly, goo.gl, ht.ly,
is.gd, ow.ly, rebrand.ly, t.co, tiny.cc, and tinyurl.com. Such URLs are replaced with
with links generated by Telnyx. The use of custom links can improve branding and message
deliverability.

To disable this feature, set the object field to `null`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|string|true|none|One of the domains provided by the Telnyx URL shortener service.<br>|
|prefix|string|false|none|Optional prefix that can be used to identify your brand, and will appear in the Telnyx generated URLs after the domain name.<br>|
|replace_blacklist_only|boolean|false|none|Use the link replacement tool only for links that are specifically blacklisted by Telnyx.<br>|
|send_webhooks|boolean|false|none|Receive webhooks for when your replaced links are clicked. Webhooks are sent to the webhooks on the messaging profile.<br>|
