<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemawirelessconnectivitylog"></a>
<a id="schema_WirelessConnectivityLog"></a>
<a id="tocSwirelessconnectivitylog"></a>
<a id="tocswirelessconnectivitylog"></a>

```json
{
  "apn": "data00.telnyx",
  "id": 137509451,
  "imei": "490154203237518",
  "imsi": 81932214823362980,
  "ipv4": "192.168.0.0",
  "ipv6": "2001:cdba:0000:0000:0000:0000:3257:9652",
  "log_type": "registration",
  "mobile_country_code": "310",
  "mobile_network_code": "410",
  "radio_access_technology": "LTE",
  "record_type": "wireless_connectivity_log",
  "sim_card_id": "6a09cdc3-8948-47f0-aa62-74ac943d6c58",
  "start_time": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
  "state": "provisioned",
  "stop_time": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z"
}
```

This object represents a wireless connectivity session log that happened through a SIM card. It aids in finding out potential problems when the SIM is not able to attach properly.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apn|string|false|read-only|The Access Point Name (APN) identifies the packet data network that a mobile data user wants to communicate with.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|Uniquely identifies the session.|
|imei|string|false|read-only|The International Mobile Equipment Identity (or IMEI) is a number, usually unique, that identifies the device currently being used connect to the network.|
|imsi|string|false|read-only|SIM cards are identified on their individual operator networks by a unique International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI). <br/><br>Mobile network operators connect mobile phone calls and communicate with their market SIM cards using their IMSIs. The IMSI is stored in the Subscriber  Identity Module (SIM) inside the device and is sent by the device to the appropriate network. It is used to acquire the details of the device in the Home  Location Register (HLR) or the Visitor Location Register (VLR).<br>|
|ipv4|string|false|read-only|The SIM's address in the currently connected network. This IPv4 address is usually obtained dynamically, so it may vary according to the location or new connections.<br>|
|ipv6|string|false|read-only|The SIM's address in the currently connected network. This IPv6 address is usually obtained dynamically, so it may vary according to the location or new connections.<br>|
|log_type|string|false|read-only|The type of the session, 'registration' being the initial authentication session and 'data' the actual data transfer sessions.|
|mobile_country_code|string|false|read-only|It's a three decimal digit that identifies a country.<br/><br/><br>This code is commonly seen joined with a Mobile Network Code (MNC) in a tuple that allows identifying a carrier known as PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) code.|
|mobile_network_code|string|false|read-only|It's a two to three decimal digits that identify a network.<br/><br/><br> This code is commonly seen joined with a Mobile Country Code (MCC) in a tuple that allows identifying a carrier known as PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) code.|
|radio_access_technology|string|false|read-only|The radio technology the SIM card used during the session.|
|record_type|string|false|read-only|none|
|sim_card_id|string(uuid)|false|none|The identification UUID of the related SIM card resource.|
|start_time|string|false|read-only|ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the session started.|
|state|string|false|read-only|The state of the SIM card after when the session happened.|
|stop_time|string|false|read-only|ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the session ended.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|log_type|registration|
|log_type|data|

<a id="schemavalidate_address"></a>
<a id="schema_validate_address"></a>
<a id="tocSvalidate_address"></a>
<a id="tocsvalidate_address"></a>

```json
true
```

Indicates whether or not the address should be validated for emergency use upon creation or not. This should be left with the default value of `true` unless you have used the `/addresses/actions/validate` endpoint to validate the address separately prior to creation. If an address is not validated for emergency use upon creation and it is not valid, it will not be able to be used for emergency services.

<h2 id="tocS_webhook_delivery">webhook_delivery</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemawebhook_delivery"></a>
<a id="schema_webhook_delivery"></a>

<a id="tocswebhook_delivery"></a>

```json
{
  "attempts": [
    {
      "finished_at": "2020-08-10T14:00:05.595Z",
      "http": {
        "request": {
          "headers": [
            "Accept: */*"
          ],
          "url": "https://fallback.example.com/webhooks"
        },
        "response": {
          "body": "All good.",
          "headers": [
            "Content-Type: text/html"
          ],
          "status": 200
        }
      },
      "started_at": "2020-08-10T14:00:05.364Z",
      "status": "delivered"
    },
    {
      "errors": [
        {
          "code": "75499",
          "detail": "The server returned another HTTP 4XX error",
          "title": "Webhook host returned HTTP 4XX"
        }
      ],
      "finished_at": "2020-08-10T14:00:05.360Z",
      "http": {
        "request": {
          "headers": [
            "Accept: */*"
          ],
          "url": "https://typo.example.com/webhooks"
        },
        "response": {
          "body": "Oops. Not found.",
          "headers": [
            "Content-Type: text/html",
            "Pragma: no-cache"
          ],
          "status": 404
        }
      },
      "started_at": "2020-08-10T14:00:05.004Z",
      "status": "failed"
    }
  ],
  "finished_at": "2020-08-10T14:00:05.595Z",
  "id": "f5586561-8ff0-4291-a0ac-84fe544797bd",
  "record_type": "webhook_delivery",
  "started_at": "2020-08-10T14:00:00.000Z",
  "status": "delivered",
  "user_id": "0ccc7b54-4df3-4bca-a65a-3da1ecc777f0",
  "webhook": {
    "event_type": "call_initiated",
    "id": "C9C0797E-901D-4349-A33C-C2C8F31A92C2",
    "occurred_at": "2020-08-10T13:02:01.000Z",
    "payload": {
      "useful": "information"
    },
    "record_type": "event"
  }
}
```

Record of all attempts to deliver a webhook.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attempts|[[attempt](#schemaattempt)]|false|none|Detailed delivery attempts, ordered by most recent.|
|finished_at|string(date-time)|false|none|ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the last webhook response has been received.|
|id|string(uuid)|false|none|Uniquely identifies the webhook_delivery record.|
|record_type|string|false|none|Identifies the type of the resource.|
|started_at|string(date-time)|false|none|ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the first request attempt was initiated.|
|status|string|false|none|Delivery status: 'delivered' when successfuly delivered or 'failed' if all attempts have failed.|
|user_id|string(uuid)|false|none|Uniquely identifies the user that owns the webhook_delivery record.|
|webhook|object|false|none|Original webhook JSON data. Payload fields vary according to event type.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|delivered|
|status|failed|
